jobs.title: Patent Engineer (Life Sciences)
jobs.description:
The way companies innovate is broken. The systems built to create and protect ideas can’t keep up with the pace of change. Today, 90% of S&P 500 company value is intangible (e.g., in intellectual property) - yet R&D and IP teams spend half their time buried in manual work, sifting through patents and paperwork instead of pushing the frontier forward. The tools of creating and protecting are stuck in the past. We’re here to fix that.

Ankar is building the R&D tools for the AI era and defining what applied research will look like in the next 20 years. We’re building infrastructure and product experiences our customers rely on every day. You’ll translate messy, ambiguous problems into clean, dependable software—and you’ll do it at the cutting-edge of AI.

We’re at an inflection point:

  • We’ve raised >$24M to date from Tier-1 VCs like Atomico, Index Ventures, Norrsken, Daphni, and angels like the Founder of Hugging Face, CEO from Datadog, and Leaders from DeepMind and OpenAI.

  • We’re already working with the world’s most innovative companies including Fortune 500 company L’Oréal and global law firm Vorys

  • Expanding our world-class team with alumni from Palantir, Amazon, and BCG to tackle the $1T+ innovation market. We’re just getting started.

What you’ll be doing
We’re looking for a patent professional with deep large-molecule life sciences expertise who can bridge product development, engineering and IP protection. You’ll work hands-on with pharmaceutical and biotech customers to design AI-powered patent solutions that understand the nuances of biologics—including antibodies, proteins, peptides, nucleic acids, vaccines and cell and gene therapies—and the conventions that govern their patent protection.

  • Build life sciences-specific patent products: Partner with product and engineering teams to develop AI tools tailored to large-molecule patents—from protein and antibody sequence analysis to biologics claim generation, sequence-listing support and prior-art searching across life sciences databases.

  • Embed with pharmaceutical and biotech customers: Work directly with in-house patent counsel and prosecution teams to design, prototype and deploy high-value proofs of concept for large-molecule patent workflows.

  • Shape product development with biologics expertise: Translate complex large-molecule patent challenges into product requirements, ensuring our AI understands sequence data, CDR and epitope definitions, functional claim language, sequence variants, experimental data and biologics drafting conventions.

  • Drive customer success in large-molecule patents: Lead technical sessions with patent professionals to ensure our products deliver measurable value across biologics patent portfolios.

  • Identify emerging biologics patent opportunities: Recognize evolving needs across therapeutic antibodies, recombinant proteins, vaccines, nucleic acid technologies, cell and gene therapies, biologics formulations and regulatory IP strategy.

What we’re looking for

  • Large-molecule patent expertise: At least two years of experience in biologics patent prosecution, pharmaceutical or biotech IP, or other large-molecule-focused patent work, with a strong understanding of the patent lifecycle from invention disclosure through prosecution, grant and enforcement.

  • Technical life sciences foundation: Strong knowledge of molecular biology, biochemistry, immunology or a related discipline, including an understanding of protein and nucleic acid sequences, antibody structure and function, biologics development, and how these translate into patentable subject matter.

  • Strong biologics drafting skills: Experience developing claim strategies for antibodies, proteins, nucleic acids or other biologic modalities, with an understanding of written-description, enablement, sequence-listing and functional-claiming requirements.

  • Builder’s mindset: You thrive in ambiguity, iterate quickly on prototypes and enjoy creating order from complexity. You can move seamlessly between high-level patent strategy and detailed biologics claim construction.

  • Extreme ownership: You anticipate problems, take responsibility for outcomes and consistently deliver. This is how you grow—and how we win.

  • [Bonus points]: Experience at a patent law firm representing pharmaceutical or biotech clients; in-house patent counsel experience at a pharmaceutical or biotech company; expertise in emerging modalities such as antibody-drug conjugates, bispecific antibodies, RNA therapeutics or cell and gene therapies; or an advanced life sciences degree combined with patent training.

     
 

This role is not for you if...

  • You need a highly structured environment, a predefined playbook, regular working hours, or a schedule that never requires travel. We operate with high autonomy and ownership, expect our team to go above and beyond, be obsessed with our mission and thrive in ambiguity rather than wait for direction.

  • You prefer long planning cycles and certainty before acting. We move quickly, ship often, and adapt based on customer feedback and new information.

  • You want to manage the work rather than do the work. We're builders first, and everyone is expected to contribute directly to creating exceptional products.

  • You take it personally when ideas are challenged, priorities shift, or work gets redirected. We care more about finding the right answer than defending a particular one.

 

What we put behind our people

Building at the frontier takes exceptional people. We invest accordingly.

  • Health Insurance : Full private health & dental coverage for you and your dependents.

  • Pension: Flexible pension scheme with up to 5% employer matching on qualifying earnings.

  • Food on us: Team lunches twice a week, plus dinner when working late in the office.

  • Cycle to work: Green Commute initiative scheme (up to £3k) to help you get a new bike tax-free.

  • Way we work: We combine deep, in-person collaboration (3 days/week in our Shoreditch office) with flexibility and trust. What matters is ownership, impact, and results, not where you work from.

  • Visa sponsorship: Yes

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Role

We're looking for a senior AI Engineer for a consulting assignment focused on building AI-driven capabilities in a business-critical, quality-sensitive setting for a company within healthcare/medtech.

Responsibilities

    Build AI functions that turn clinical content into practical, actionable suggestions for therapists in their daily work.
    Design end-to-end pipelines, including prompt and chain architectures, with structured outputs broken into clear, independently testable steps.
    Own model selection and strategy, including fine-tuning open-weight models.
    Help establish a data foundation with measurable quality, ensuring data is de-identified, version-controlled, and reproducible.
    Define per-function evaluation methodology — identifying which error types matter most and what quality bar must be met before output reaches a human reviewer.
    Set up regression testing and continuous quality monitoring in production.
    Build traceability mechanisms capturing what the AI suggests versus what the reviewer approves or edits, supporting transparency and long-term improvement.

Required Skills

    Proven experience building LLM-based systems that run in production, not just proof-of-concept work.
    Able to give concrete examples of how you've iterated on and improved live solutions over time.
    Strong background across data modeling, pipeline development, and model-related engineering.
    Clear understanding of why versioning datasets matters as much as versioning code.
    Experience handling sensitive personal data, with a real grasp of how nuanced de-identification can be.
    Comfortable working against defined quality bars rather than optimizing for a demo.
    Understands the stakes of reliability in AI systems, particularly where mistakes carry real consequences.
    Consulting mindset: able to step into an existing team, collaborate closely with domain experts, and leave behind solutions others can maintain.

Nice to Have

    Background in medical technology, healthcare, or other regulated fields with strong traceability requirements.
    Experience with speech-to-text systems, particularly for Swedish as a lower-resource language.
    Familiarity with the .NET ecosystem.

At International English School (IES), we make a difference for our students. International English School (IES) Kista is part of Sweden's largest and most successful network of bilingual schools and accepts students in grades F–9. IES Kista has 640 students and 79 employees. We follow the Swedish curriculum (Lgr22) where up to 50% of the teaching is in English.

At IES Kista, we believe in high academic expectations, bilingual education (English and Swedish), and mutual respect between students and staff. We strive to equip each student with knowledge, confidence, and a strong sense of responsibility to prepare them for future success. Our school is a community of professionals, and whether you are new to the profession or an experienced educator, you will have the opportunity to develop with us.

Nous cherchons des ingénieurs qui ne se concentrent pas uniquement sur l'implémentation: poser les bons problèmes, comprendre les utilisateurs-ices, et tenir l'architecture sur le long terme.

- Problem solving : capacité à décomposer des problèmes complexes, identifier les vrais enjeux métier et faire les bons compromis techniques

- Architecture système : capacité à concevoir et faire évoluer une architecture web modulaire, scalable et maintenable

- Habitué à travailler et/ou définir un design system.

- Maîtrise des bonnes pratiques de développement : typage & lint de code, tests unitaires et fonctionnels, documentation, revues de code, composition, architecture modulaire par domaines métier.

- Apprécié : notions de Python/Django pour naviguer entre vues et templates, expérience du mobile hybride (capacitorjs).

- Bac +5 université ou équivalent

- Goût pour les belles choses

- Enthousiasme à explorer comment l'IA peut élever notre métier, nos produits et nos workflows

jobs.title: Shopify Manager (m/w/d) - Conversion, Funnel & Shop-Entwicklung
jobs.description:
Du willst nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten, sondern einen Shop wirklich verantworten? Bei NEOLYMP übernimmst du unseren Shopify-Shop in einer Phase, in der jede Optimierung sichtbar auf Umsatz und Wachstum wirkt – von der Landingpage bis zur letzten Zeile Liquid.

Wer wir sind

NEOLYMP ist eine Berliner Fitnessmarke, gegründet 2018. Wir entwickeln innovatives Fitnessequipment und ganzheitliche Trainingskonzepte für zu Hause – vom durchdachten Home-Gym-Equipment bis hin zu Online-Kursen, die Training, Motivation und Alltag zusammenbringen.

Warum diese Rolle:

  • Echte Verantwortung: Der Shop ist dein Bereich. Du entscheidest, was gebaut und getestet wird – und setzt es selbst um.
  • Sichtbarer Impact: Conversion Rate, Bestellwert, Ladezeit – alles, was du bewegst, siehst du direkt in den Zahlen.
  • Funnel-Fokus: Landingpages und Funnel-Seiten sind bei uns kein Nebenthema, sondern der Kern unseres Wachstums.
  • Kein Silo: Du arbeitest eng mit Marketing und Performance zusammen und bist die Schnittstelle, die Ideen in fertige Seiten übersetzt.

Benefits:

  • Vollständige Remote-Arbeit mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten.
  • “Spenditcard” mit 50€ steuerfreier Sachprämie monatlich zur freien Verfügung.
  • Regelmäßige Team-Events und ein motiviertes, modernes Arbeitsumfeld in einer schnell wachsenden E-Commerce-Marke.
  • Aufbau und Verantwortung eines eigenen Bereichs mit sehr viel Gestaltungsspielraum.
  • Kurze Entscheidungswege und starke Startup-Kultur mit Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten auf dich zugeschnitten.

Aufgaben

Funnel & Conversion

  • Du konzipierst und baust Landingpages und Funnel-Seiten, die Kund:innen intuitiv zur Bestellung führen.
  • Du optimierst unsere Produktseiten verkaufspsychologisch – von Struktur und Aufbau bis ins Detail.
  • Du baust Upsells, Bundles und Trust-Elemente ein, die den durchschnittlichen Bestellwert messbar steigern.

Testing & Analyse

  • Du planst A/B-Tests, wertest sie aus und leitest daraus die nächsten Maßnahmen ab.
  • Du analysierst Conversion Rate, Customer Journey und Bestellwert laufend und erkennst, wo Potenzial liegt.

Technik & Performance

  • Du entwickelst unser Shopify-Theme eigenständig weiter und setzt neue Features direkt im Code um.
  • Du hältst den Shop technisch auf Top-Niveau – Ladezeiten, Performance und SEO inklusive.

Qualifikation

Das ist uns wichtig

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit Shopify und ein sicheres Verständnis von Theme-Architektur und Liquid.
  • Solide HTML- und CSS-Kenntnisse, um Features eigenständig umzusetzen.
  • Ein starkes Marketing- und Conversion-Verständnis: Du weißt, wie verkaufsstarke Produktseiten, Landingpages und Customer Journeys aufgebaut sind.
  • Erfahrung mit CRO, A/B-Testing und Heat Maps.
  • Eine datengetriebene Arbeitsweise – du triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlen, nicht aus dem Bauch.
  • Hands-on-Mentalität: Du setzt Dinge um, statt auf Zuarbeit zu warten.

Das zählt für uns am meisten

  • Lust und Motivation, dich weiterzuentwickeln und mit der Rolle zu wachsen. Die nächsten Meilensteine erreichen wir gemeinsam – dafür ist uns Drive wichtiger als das perfekte Profil.

Nice to have

  • Erfahrung mit Klaviyo oder vergleichbaren E-Mail-Marketing-Tools (Newsletter-Kampagnen, automatisierte Flows).

So arbeiten wir:

  • Remote first: Du arbeitest vollständig remote mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten – wir messen Ergebnisse, nicht Anwesenheit.
  • Im Team: Du bist Teil eines hochmotivierten Teams aus Marketing, Performance und E-Commerce, das gemeinsam an einem Ziel zieht.
  • Kurze Wege: Entscheidungen fallen schnell, Feedback ist direkt, und gute Ideen werden umgesetzt, nicht vertagt.
  • Startup-Kultur mit Substanz: Wir sind seit 2018 am Markt, wachsen profitabel und haben trotzdem den Drive der ersten Stunde behalten.Klingt nach dir?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung – und darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Kontakt: Josephine Steuer

Wir glauben, dass Vielfalt uns stärker macht. Deshalb heißen wir alle Bewerbenden willkommen, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Religion, Alter, sexueller Identität oder Behinderung. Bei uns gibt es keinen Dresscode und wir duzen uns einfach. Der Einfachheit halber verwenden wir im Text eine Sprachform, schließen damit aber ausdrücklich alle Menschen ein.

jobs.title: Senior Industrialisation Engineer (m/f/d) - EFT Mobility AG
jobs.description:
Join EFT Mobility at a pivotal time as we revolutionize the future of electric transport, focusing on cutting-edge Electric Powertrain (EFT) solutions for high-reliability applications, including UAV power systems. We are a fast-growing, dynamic company where every engineer plays a direct, hands-on role in bringing our innovative, safety-critical products to life. If you thrive on ensuring product quality and solving complex, real-world problems, we want you on our team.

We are seeking a highly skilled, execution-driven and hands-on Senior Industrialisation Engineer to bridge the gap between R&D and mass manufacturing for our battery packs and charger product lines.

In this role, your primary focus will be the electro-mechanical process steps and optimizations required to transform a functional prototype into a robust, high-yield, and highly scalable series product. You will take ownership of the product lifecycle immediately following the initial prototype build phase. Collaborating closely with our external Contract Manufacturers (CMs), you will co-architect the manufacturing lines, advise on critical assembly fixtures, and pave the way for a production ramp-up from pre-series batches into stable mass production.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Review designs directly following R&D prototype runs to actively catch and eliminate mechanical tolerance stack-ups and assembly risks before tooling begins.

  • Optimise the design, sourcing, and validation of mechanical assembly jigs, cell-alignment fixtures, glueing fixtures, laser-welding beds to optimize line repeatability and operator safety.

  • Collaborate regularly with Contract Manufacturers to optimise and release assembly line setups, resolve technical build bottlenecks, and transition pilot runs into high-yield mass production.

  • Conduct hands-on Design of Experiments in the lab and factory floor to establish locked-in process windows for automated gluing, thermal interface material (TIM) dispensing, and torque specs.

  • Co-Own build failures together with the contract manufacturer to rapidly drive engineering adjustments and optimize first-pass yields. Page: 1/3

  • Oversee the EoL failures, analyse them and implement solutions to improve yield.


What you bring to the team:

  • Experience: 8+ years of experience as an Industrialization, Manufacturing, or NPI (New Product Introduction) Engineer, specifically driving the scale-up (upto 10-30k units) of battery modules/packs, power electronics enclosures, or high-reliability electromechanical systems.

  • Technical Skills: Highly skilled in (mechanical) production processes, experience with failure analysis and production methods in a semi-automised production environment.

  • Hands-on Workshop Mentality: A deeply practical engineer who thrives on the shop floor or in the prototype lab. You have no hesitation when it comes to standing at the line, personally assembling a battery module to understand a build bottleneck, or physically tearing down hardware to isolate a defect.

  • Design Review & CAD Interpretation: Strong ability to navigate, interpret, and evaluate 3D CAD models and engineering drawings.

  • Communication: Strong ability to translate technical failure data intoactionable engineering changes.

  • Project Management & CM Governance: Strong capability to coordinate complex technical tasks across internal engineering design teams and external contract manufacturers, with the technical confidence to regularly audit and challenge the work of the CM's internal industrialization teams

Your Benefits: 

  • Direct impact: See your contributions rapidly integrated from cutting-edge research into industrialized products, flying in the field within short development cycles. 

  • Culture & Environment: A dynamic, fast-paced, and collaborative startup environment with flat hierarchies, efficient collaboration, and a strong emphasis on continuous learning opportunities. 

  • Work-life Balance: We offer flexible work schedules, and 30 days of paid vacation each year to support your personal and professional life. 

  • Lunch Benefit: We promote healthy eating and the well-being of our employees with a monthly lunch budget. 

  • Mobility Benefit: With our mobility budget, we pay your “Germany Ticket” for work or personal use monthly. 

  • Health & Wellness: We support your physical well-being with a company-subsidized eGym Wellpass membership, giving you access to thousands of gyms and sports facilities. 

  • Language Courses: German isn’t your mother tongue? We sponsor German courses for you to quickly learn and integrate even more.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager Service Cockpit (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir suchen

… als Senior Product Manager:in Service Cockpit entwickelst du einen intern getesteten Prototypen zu einer produktiven Anwendung weiter. Damit können unsere Servicetechniker:innen Wärmepumpen aus der Ferne prüfen, Fehler schneller eingrenzen und sichere Einstellungen vornehmen.
Dein Ziel: weniger Vor-Ort-Einsätze und ein Werkzeug, das im Servicealltag wirklich hilft.

Du verbindest Daten aus verschiedenen Herstellerwelten und baust das Produkt selbst, mit AI als deinem Entwicklungsteam. Du spezifizierst, gestaltest, baust, bringst es live und betreibst es. Ein eigenes Entwicklungsteam gibt es für diese Rolle nicht, und es wird keines geben. Wer Tickets schreiben und übergeben will, ist hier falsch.


Wenn Du daran Spaß hast

  • das Service Cockpit gemeinsam mit unseren Techniker:innen von der Discovery bis zum Betrieb aufzubauen, den intern getesteten Read-only-Prototypen in kurzen Zyklen zu einer stabilen Produktivanwendung weiterzuentwickeln und die technische Basis selbst festzulegen
  • ein kanonisches Datenmodell für unsere eigene Wärmepumpenplattform sowie die Systeme von Buderus und LG zu definieren und mit unserem Datenteam umzusetzen
  • fehlende Messwerte, unklare Fehlercodes, technische Datenlücken und fehlende Zugänge mit Analytics, HEMS, Platform, IT, Security und den Herstellern zu klären
  • sichere Schreibzugriffe für ausgewählte Einstellungen zu bauen, Rollen und Berechtigungen abzustimmen und wiederkehrende Wartungsaufgaben aus der Ferne zu automatisieren
  • am echten Fall mit unseren Techniker:innen zu arbeiten, vermiedene Anfahrten und die First-Time-Fix-Rate zu messen und die Plattform danach auszubauen: mit Kundenreporting, Predictive Maintenance gemeinsam mit unserem Data-Science-Team, weiteren Assetklassen, einer nativen App und der Anbindung an unsere Serviceprozesse


Und Dich hier wiedererkennst

  • Erfahrung & Ownership: Du bringst mindestens fünf Jahre Erfahrung im digitalen Produktmanagement, in Product Engineering oder mit Datenprodukten mit. Du hast Produkte selbst bis in den produktiven Einsatz gebracht, Verantwortung für ein unfertiges Produkt übernommen, eigene Prioritäten gesetzt und gemessen, ob deine Lösung im Alltag tatsächlich etwas verbessert.
  • Build-Erfahrung: Du hast eigenständig funktionierende Anwendungen mit AI-Coding-Tools gebaut. Im Gespräch zeigst du uns, was du entwickelt hast, und erklärst deine technischen Entscheidungen.
  • Datenverständnis: Du kannst dich in unbekannte Sensor-, Zeitreihen- und API-Daten einarbeiten, Zusammenhänge erkennen und benennen, welche Werte oder Zugänge fehlen. SQL und BI-Tools gehören zu deinem Arbeitsalltag. Du musst nicht jedes Datenproblem allein lösen. Du löst es mit AI, unserem Datenteam und Tech und weißt, was du dort anfordern musst.
  • Produkturteil: Du entwickelst professionelle Oberflächen für Menschen, die unter Zeitdruck arbeiten. Deine Entscheidungen leitest du aus den Aufgaben der Techniker:innen ab, nicht aus den Feldern, die ein System zufällig liefert.
  • Schnittstellenarbeit: Du hast Daten oder Zugänge von Herstellern, Dienstleistern oder internen Plattformteams beschafft und dabei auch bei Widerständen den Überblick behalten.
  • Wärmepumpen:Wärmepumpen-Expertise ist keine Voraussetzung. Niemand wird gleichzeitig Experte für drei Herstellerwelten. Wir brauchen jemanden, der in Daten erkennt, was passiert, und die richtigen Fragen stellt. Die fachliche Tiefe baust du in den ersten Monaten auf. Dafür ist Zeit vorgesehen.
  • Sprachen: Du sprichst sehr gut Englisch und mindestens Deutsch auf B2-Niveau.


Was wir Dir bieten

  • Das Bruttojahresgehalt für diese Position startet ab 80.000€ bis 92.000€*
  • Eine Unternehmenskultur, die Menschen quer durch die Gesellschaft zusammenbringt – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Herkunft, Alter oder Hintergrund.
  • Ein modernes Office mitten in Berlin-Kreuzberg mit Dachterrasse, in dem auch Hunde willkommen sind.
  • Monatliche Unternehmensevents wie Lunch & Learn und Drinks & Action.
  • Bilde Dich weiter! Regelmäßige Möglichkeiten für Trainings und Fortbildungen durch unser eigenes Learning & Development Team oder externe Coaches.
  • Beweg Dich mit Deinem JobRad, klimafreundlich durch die Stadt.
  • Die Möglichkeit, dein persönliches Wunsch-Elektroauto bequem mıt FINN JobAuto Leasing.
  • Corporate Benefits: Mitarbeiterrabatte bei über 100 Partner:innen.
  • Dein Wohlbefinden ist uns wichtig, daher investieren wir für dich in deine physische sowie psychische Gesundheit und bieten dir neben 30 Tagen Urlaub und weiteren zahlreiche Vergünstigungen über die Corporate Benefits auch eine vergünstigte Urban Sports Mitgliedschaft und Zugang zu nilo.health, einer Plattform zur mentalen Gesundheitsvorsorge.
  • Sicherheit & Vorsorge: Wir bieten Dir einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag und sorgen für Deine Zukunft: Dein Beitrag zur bAV und BUV wird durch einen erhöhten Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 20% unterstützt.


Über uns

Jede Bewerbung ist willkommen bei uns - unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter, sexueller Orientierung oder Identität. Wir sind überzeugt, jeder Mensch ist wertvoll und verdient eine faire Chance.

Aber wir glauben, beim eigenen Heim geht es künftig um mehr - nämlich um die Generationen, die nach uns kommen. Wir glauben, unsere Häuser können mehr! Sie können elektrifiziert, intelligent, effizient, unabhängig und klimaneutral sein. Wir glauben, klimaneutrales Wohnen sollte für jeden zugänglich, erschwinglich und einfach sein. Und mit jeder Wärmepumpe vor unseren Häusern, jeder Photovoltaikanlage auf unseren Dächern und jeder Wallbox in unseren Garagen leisten wir einen Beitrag für klimaneutrales Wohnen.

Wir glauben nicht nur an klimaneutrales Wohnen – wir ermöglichen es.
Für Millionen von Eigenheimen. Gemeinsam. Jeden Tag. Heim für Heim.


Dein Bewerbungsprozess

  • Abschließend bist Du in einem finalen Gespräch mit einigen deiner potenzieller Teamkollegen
  • Sind alle glücklich? Herzlich willkommen bei thermondo.

autarc is building the operating system for energy installers across Europe. As we scale, we want our Go-to-Market organization to operate with the same level of automation, data quality, and product thinking as our engineering organization.

Role description

What You’ll Do

Work on our GTM operating system

  • Build the systems powering our entire customer lifecycle – from first lead to closed customer and expansion.

  • Connect our GTM stack and ensure information moves reliably between systems.


Integrate AI into real workflows

  • Move AI beyond prototypes.

  • Build AI-powered workflows that help us qualify and prioritize leads, analyze calls and customer interactions, identify opportunities and risks, generate insights, and automate operational work.

Build, don’t just recommend

  • You should be comfortable moving between commercial conversations and technical implementation.


Drive measurable commercial impact

  • Technology is a means, not the outcome.

  • Your work should ultimately help us generate more pipeline, increase conversion, shorten sales cycles, improve retention, or allow our GTM organization to scale without adding unnecessary complexity.

  • You will work closely with GTM leadership to identify the highest-leverage problems and own them from idea to measurable result.


Requirements

  • You are a builder. When you see a broken process, your instinct is to understand it and build something better.

  • You have strong technical skills and have worked in Python and/or TypeScript

Was wir bieten

An internship with direct influence on how autarc scales its commercial organization.

The opportunity to build GTM infrastructure and directly collaborate with our founders and GTM leadership.

A strong engineering and product culture combined with an ambitious commercial organization.

A beautiful office in Berlin and a team that values working together in person.

MacBook and everything else you need to do your best work.

Most importantly: a role where your output can directly influence how quickly autarc grows

Why autarc?

autarc is building the AI operating system for energy installers.

Our platform helps installers manage the entire workflow around renewable energy projects – from lead and site assessment to technical planning, offers, documentation, installation, and ongoing operations.

We already serve more than 2,000 businesses and are expanding our platform across Europe.

As our Go-to-Market Engineer, you won’t inherit a finished system. You will help design the next generation of our commercial infrastructure.

No endless strategy decks. No six-month implementation projects.

Find the bottleneck. Build the solution. Measure whether it worked. Improve it.

jobs.title: Assisterende butikkleder
jobs.description:
Kid/Hemtex er i dag en av Nordens ledende interiør- og tekstilkjeder, med mer enn 280 fysiske butikker og nettbutikk, representert i Norge, Sverige, Finland og Estland. Vi tilbyr et bredt og inspirerende utvalg av kvalitetsprodukter til gode priser. Hos oss blir du en del av et fremoverlent selskap som ønsker å fortsette å vokse og utvikle seg. Vi verdsetter fellesskap og en prestisjefri kultur, der du som medarbeider får muligheten til å påvirke og bidra i vår utvikling. Våre verdier Kremmerånd, Inspirasjon og Dedikasjon - veileder oss og gjennomsyrer alt vi gjør.

 

Brenner du for Retail? Har du en kremmer i magen og får du energi av å yte topp service? Elsker du i tillegg interiør, tekstil, møbler og trender? Trives du også med at du får dine 8.000 skritt i løpet av en arbeidsdag, og at en dag aldri er lik den neste? Da er vi i Kid kanskje en perfekt match for deg!

Vi søker etter en assisterende butikkleder i 60 % stilling til Kid Thon senter Sandvika.

Som en rollemodell og butikkleders «høyre hånd» skal du igjennom engasjerende kommunikasjon, involvering og oppmuntring bidra til å bygge et godt team som sammen leverer gode resultater av høy kvalitet. Menneskene er vår største styrke, og vi vet at vi vil lykkes om vi har et godt arbeidsmiljø. Du vil få muligheten til å utfordre deg selv, og sammen med din butikkleder løfte butikken til nye høyder.

 

Vi har spurt våre kolleger om hva som er det beste med å jobbe i Kid, og da svarer de:

«Kid har gode verdier og evner å se enkeltindividene»

«Det er enkelt å lære seg å bli flink i jobben sin og det gir en god mestringsfølelse»

«Det legges til rette for gode fremtidsutsikter og Kid er en trygg arbeidsgiver»

«Kid er folkelig og nedpå, og det liker jeg godt!»

 

Hva vil være ansvaret ditt?

  • At du og butikkleder, gjennom delegering, inkludering og «heiarop», sørger for at teamet får ryggsekken full av mestringsopplevelser
  • At dere, sammen med teamet, skaper en inspirerende butikk med en kundeservice som gjør at kundene opplever det «godt å komme hjem»
  • At dere, sammen med teamet, er dedikerte kremmere, som finner løsninger på utfordringer og elsker tempo og variasjon
  • At dere, sammen med teamet, følger konsept og leverer høy kvalitet, som igjen gir god måloppnåelse og sunne driftsresultater

 

Vi ser for oss at du:

  • Har erfaring fra salg- og service
  • Har naturlige lederegenskaper, og synes at ledelse er meningsfullt
  • Trives med å jobbe ut ifra konsept, har estetisk sans og et visuelt sterkt øye
  • Trigges av resultater, og har ambisjoner på egne og andres vegne
  • Er «fremme i skoene», tar initiativ og liker at ingen dag er lik en annen

 

Vi tilbyr:

  • En utfordrende stilling i en kjede med spennende produkter
  • Gode karriere- og utviklingsmuligheter
  • En «levende» bransje med store variasjoner, hvor den enkeltes innsats teller
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø
  • Et bonussystem for alle medarbeidere som er ansatt over 20%.

 

Med en veldreven organisasjon og et godt støtteapparat i ryggen, ligger alt til rette for at du skal lykkes i rollen. Din nærmeste leder er butikkleder. Du vil bli del av et sammensveiset team med dyktige kolleger, både i egen butikk, i regionen og som en del av et stort nordisk konsern.

NB! Vennligst ikke send søknaden din pr e-post til oss. Kun søknader som sendes via vår rekrutteringsportal vil bli vurdert. Gå inn på karrieresiden vår karriere.kid.no for å sende oss en søknad.

 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Kid Interiør er Nordens største tekstil- og interiørkonsern. Konsernet består av kjedene Kid Interiør med en butikkportefølje av ca 150 butikker i Norge, og Hemtex med ca 140 butikker i Sverige, Finland og Estland. Begge kjedene driver i tillegg sine egne nettbutikker som er i sterk vekst. ...

jobs.title: UX Engineer
jobs.description:
On behalf of a partner company, Nordic Investin is looking for an UX Engineer. You like the space where design intent meets browser behaviour, component APIs and the reality of production code.

The partner is creating a design system and improving complex web workflows. You will prototype interactions, build accessible components and help designers and engineers make decisions using working software.

The team works across disciplines and expects quality to be shaped throughout discovery and delivery. You will have space to challenge assumptions, make evidence visible and improve how decisions are made.

How you will work

You will join multidisciplinary delivery rather than operate as a final approval step. The partner expects early questions, rapid feedback and clear evidence about what users and systems need. You will help teams decide what to test, measure or prototype before committing to an expensive direction.

You will receive meaningful ownership while working with senior colleagues on the most consequential decisions. The partner expects you to deliver independently within a clear area, ask for context early and contribute ideas grounded in what you observe. There is room to deepen your specialism or broaden toward adjacent responsibilities.

What you will do

    

Develop production ready components in React and TypeScript.

    

Translate design concepts into responsive interactive prototypes.

    

Define accessibility behaviour and test with assistive technology.

    

Improve design tokens, documentation and component APIs.

    

Collaborate on research and turn findings into interface changes.

    

Support adoption across product teams.

What you will bring

    

Strong frontend development with excellent HTML and CSS.

    

React and TypeScript experience.

    

Ability to work confidently in design tools and code.

    

Practical accessibility knowledge.

    

Good visual judgement and attention to interaction detail.

    

Professional English and collaborative critique skills.

Experience that would add value

    

Design system ownership.

    

Motion, data visualisation or prototyping tools.

    

Experience in workflow heavy enterprise products.

A background that can succeed here

You may be a frontend engineer with strong design sensibility or a product designer who writes production quality code. The partner is interested in the bridge you create between disciplines rather than the label you started with.

What makes the opportunity interesting

This role gives you leverage across several products and close collaboration with design and engineering leaders. You will improve both the visible interface and the system teams use to build it.

The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the context, expectations and decision path before you are asked to commit significant time.

The recruitment conversation

During the process, Nordic Investin will focus on concrete decisions you have made: the context you received, the alternatives you considered, the result you observed and what you would change today. You do not need every optional technology if your core experience transfers and you can explain how you would close the gap.

How to apply

Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note describing the most relevant system, product or transformation you have helped deliver. Nordic Investin welcomes candidates with different routes into technology and assesses applicants on relevant capability, judgement and potential.

jobs.title: QA and Test Lead
jobs.description:
One of Nordic Investin’s partner companies is looking for a QA and Test Lead, with Nordic Investin leading the recruitment process. You can create a quality strategy that teams understand, own and use when delivery pressure rises.

The partner is delivering a complex platform change across several systems and suppliers. You will lead test planning, coordinate evidence and make sure critical user journeys are verified from component level through business acceptance.

The team works across disciplines and expects quality to be shaped throughout discovery and delivery. You will have space to challenge assumptions, make evidence visible and improve how decisions are made.

How you will work

You will join multidisciplinary delivery rather than operate as a final approval step. The partner expects early questions, rapid feedback and clear evidence about what users and systems need. You will help teams decide what to test, measure or prototype before committing to an expensive direction.

As a senior colleague, you will own substantial outcomes and help others make stronger decisions. You are expected to recognise risk early, communicate it without drama and move work forward with practical alternatives. The role still includes hands on delivery; seniority here means broader judgement, not distance from the work.

What you will do

    

Define the overall test strategy and risk based scope.

    

Connect requirements and use cases with verifiable test coverage.

    

Coordinate environments, data, teams and external dependencies.

    

Lead defect triage and readiness reporting.

    

Guide automation priorities and non functional testing.

    

Communicate quality risk clearly to project and business leadership.

What you will bring

    

Extensive test leadership in complex technology programmes.

    

Strong requirements, integration and acceptance testing experience.

    

Ability to plan across several teams and release stages.

    

Evidence based reporting and defect management.

    

Understanding of test automation and modern delivery methods.

    

Professional English; Swedish may be required for public partners.

Experience that would add value

    

Procurement or implementation of a major business system.

    

Performance, security or resilience test coordination.

    

Experience in healthcare, government or another regulated domain.

A background that can succeed here

You may come from hands on testing, business analysis or programme quality management. The partner needs someone who can discuss detail with engineers and provide a concise risk view to decision makers.

What makes the opportunity interesting

This role gives you a central position in a consequential change programme. You will shape how quality is demonstrated and help the organisation make release decisions based on evidence rather than optimism.

The exact partner, employment model, compensation, start date and working arrangement will be explained openly during the process. Nordic Investin will make sure you understand the context, expectations and decision path before you are asked to commit significant time.

The recruitment conversation

During the process, Nordic Investin will focus on concrete decisions you have made: the context you received, the alternatives you considered, the result you observed and what you would change today. You do not need every optional technology if your core experience transfers and you can explain how you would close the gap.

How to apply

Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile and a short note describing the most relevant system, product or transformation you have helped deliver. Nordic Investin welcomes candidates with different routes into technology and assesses applicants on relevant capability, judgement and potential.

jobs.title: Arbetsterapeut till vård- och omsorgsboende Stockholm
jobs.description:
Vi söker

dig som är leg. arbetsterapeut med erfarenhet inom äldreomsorgen och som värdesätter ett arbetssätt där patienten sätts i fokus. Din kompetens och kreativitet ligger till grund för att varje individs behov tillgodoses med hänsyn till personens förutsättningar. I din yrkesroll är du självgående samtidigt som god kommunikation och samarbete faller dig naturligt liksom ett trevligt bemötande till vårdtagare, anhöriga samt kollegor. Meriterande om du tidigare arbetat inom demensvård. Krav är att du behärskar svenska i tal och skrift.

Tjänsten är på deltid, ca 18 tim i veckan på 3 dagar

Start omgående, fram till sommaren 2027 till att börja med

Ligger centralt i Stockholmsområdet

Arbetsuppgifter

I din roll ingår sedvanliga arbetsuppgifter vilket bland annat innefattar:

- Planering och utförande av träning/aktiviteter

- Uppföljning och utvärdering av insatta åtgärder

- Utprovning, justering och förskrivning av fysiska och kognitiva hjälpmedel

- Stödja boenden till att utveckla sina fysiska, kognitiva och sociala förmågor

- Handledning av personal

- Tvärproffesionellt samarbete med bland annat undersköterskor, sjuksköterskor och fysioterapeuter

Anställning

Du kommer att bli anställd som konsult för Vårdlänken Bemanning och Rekrytering med varierande arbetstider och tjänstegrad efter överenskommelse.

Som konsult erbjuds du konkurrenskraftig lön och intressanta uppdrag. Vi erbjuder även:

•Introduktion för att du så snabbt som möjligt ska komma in i din roll

•Regelbundna utvecklingssamtal med din närmaste chef

•Kontinuerlig coachning för att följa hur du når dina uppsatta mål

•Inbjudningar till seminarier och konsultträffar

•Friskvårdsbidrag

Det finns flera fördelar med att välja att arbeta som konsult för Vårdlänken. Som konsult kan du alltid känna dig trygg med att din konsultchef förstår dina och kundens behov, eftersom din konsultchef själv har varit verksam inom samma arbetsområde som du arbetar inom. Det finns stora möjligheter att själv få välja arbetsplats och arbetstider. Behöver du komma i kontakt med Vårdlänken utanför kontorstid, finns alltid en bemannad jourtelefon.

Vårdlänken är ett auktoriserat bemanningsföretag. Det innebär att Vårdlänken varje år genomgår en revision genomförd av Almega. I revisionen kontrolleras bland annat att Vårdlänken betalar de skatter och avgifter som Skatteverket beslutat och i övrigt har sunda finanser. Det ställs också krav på att Vårdlänken har gedigna ansvarsförsäkringar för sina konsulter som är ute på arbetsplatser.

Kollektivavtal är ytterligare ett krav som ställs för att få bli ett auktoriserat bemanningsföretag. Genom Vårdlänkens kollektivavtal kan du känna dig trygg i att Vårdlänken betalar in pengar till din tjänstepension från den allra första kronan som du tjänar in genom dina uppdrag hos Vårdlänken. Skulle du råka ut för en olycka i arbetet, eller till och från arbetet, kan du också känns dig trygg med att Vårdlänken har de olycksfallsförsäkringar som arbetsmarknadens parter har beslutat om.

Ansökan

jobs.title: Avdelingsleder til REMA 1000 Siljan
jobs.description:
Rema 1000 Siljan vokser og søker avdelingsleder.

Har du et øye for orden, kvalitet og gode kundeopplevelser? Er du en lagspiller som liker å ta ansvar? Som avdelingsleder hos REMA 1000 får du muligheten til å ta ansvar for din egen avdeling i butikken.

Hva går jobben ut på?🛒 
Som avdelingsleder er du ansvarlig for at din avdeling alltid er innbydende, velfylt og effektivt drevet. Du sørger for at kundene får en god handleopplevelse og at dine kolleger trives og presterer godt. I løpet av en arbeidsdag vil du blant annet:

  • Ha ansvar for drift, varebestilling, fakturering og budsjett i din avdeling
  • Sikre at avdelingen alltid er attraktiv og fylt med varer
  • Planlegge og gjennomføre kampanjer og aktiviteter
  • Opplære og følge opp kolleger i avdelingen
  • Samarbeide om å skape en velfungerende butikk

Hvem ser vi etter?🔎 
Vi ser etter deg som liker å ta ansvar og er opptatt av gode handleopplevelser. Vi tror du også kjenner deg igjen i dette:

  • Du har erfaring fra dagligvare butikk, gjerne Rema 1000 
  • Er strukturert og liker å ha orden og kontroll
  • Motiveres av å skape gode handleopplevelser for kunden – vår øverste sjef
  • Jobber godt selvstendig, men også trives i team
  • Takler hektiske situasjoner og jobber godt når det er travelt.

Hvorfor velge REMA 1000 SILJAN? 💙

I Siljan er mulighetene mange for mennesker som tør å gi av seg selv, er positive og selvstendige. Hos oss er det plass til alle – mangfold gjør oss sterkere. Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg og gleder oss til å ønske deg velkommen som en del av teamet vårt.

Hos oss får du:

  • En trivelig arbeidsplass med hyggelige kollegaer.
  • Muligheter for utvikling.
  • Et miljø hvor du får støtten du trenger til å lykkes i rollen din.
  • Variasjon og energi i hverdagen – ingen dager er helt like!

Les mer på oss på vår karriereside: https://www.rema.no/karriere/

Høres dette ut som jobben for deg? Da gleder vi oss til å høre fra deg 👋

Om rekrutteringsprosessen: I våre rekrutteringsprosesser benytter vi oss av testverktøy for å kunne bli bedre kjent med deg. Aktuelle kandidater vil motta epost med link til testene kort tid etter innsendt søknad.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

REMA 1000 er blant Norges største dagligvareaktør og en av landets sterkeste merkevarer. Siden 1979 har REMA 1000 jobbet for å kunne tilby kunder over hele landet et godt utvalg av dagligvarer til laveste pris, av høy kvalitet, produsert og solgt på en ansvarlig måte. Ved å ha hyggelige og dyktige mennesker med riktige holdninger og fokus på å jobbe med de rette tingene, har REMA 1000 lykkes med å skape en solid virksomhet som er lønnsom ikke bare for sine kjøpmenn og for bedriften - men også for kundene.
Ønsker du å lese mer om vårt arbeid med miljø og samfunnsansvar; https://www.rema.no/ansvar-i-rema-1000/

jobs.title: E-commerce & Digital Manager
jobs.description:
Ta Reformfurniture ut i Sverige – och världen.

Reformfurniture söker en driven, kreativ och mycket erfaren E-commerce & Digital Manager som vill ta ett helhetsansvar för vår digitala utveckling.

Vi är ett växande företag inom vintage, design och skandinaviska möbler, med fysisk butik och verkstad i Lund. Nu vill vi ta nästa stora steg och bygga upp Reformfurniture till en stark digital aktör – både nationellt och internationellt.

Det här är inte en roll där du bara ska förvalta en befintlig webbshop.

Vi söker dig som vill bygga, utveckla, strukturera och driva vår digitala affär framåt.

Om rollen

Du kommer att ha ett övergripande ansvar för vår e-handel och digitala närvaro. Rollen är både strategisk och operativ, vilket innebär att du behöver trivas lika bra med att tänka långsiktigt som att själv kavla upp ärmarna och producera innehåll.

Du kommer bland annat att arbeta med:

● Utveckling och löpande optimering av vår webbshop

● Strategi för ökad digital försäljning i Sverige och internationellt

● Produktfotografering och bildredigering

● Produkttexter och storytelling kring möbler, designers och designhistoria

● Publicering och strukturering av produkter på webben

● SEO och arbete för ökad organisk synlighet

● Digital marknadsföring och kampanjer

● Sociala medier och innehållsproduktion

● Nyhetsbrev och kundkommunikation

● Analys av trafik, försäljning och kundbeteende

● Utveckling av kundresan från inspiration till köp

● Internationell e-handel och utveckling av nya marknader

● Att skapa effektiva arbetssätt och rutiner kring hela vår digitala försäljning

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker framför allt erfarenhet, kunskap och driv.

Du har tidigare arbetat framgångsrikt med e-handel och förstår vad som krävs för att bygga en digital affär som faktiskt genererar försäljning.

Du behöver kunna arbeta självständigt och känna dig trygg i att ta stort eget ansvar. Hos oss kommer du få möjlighet att påverka mycket – men vi förväntar oss också att du kan komma in med idéer, lösningar och kunskap från dag ett.

Vi tror att du har:

● Flera års dokumenterad erfarenhet av e-handel

● Mycket god förståelse för webb, konvertering och digital försäljning

● Erfarenhet av CMS/e-handelsplattformar, gärna WooCommerce

● Kunskap inom SEO och digital marknadsföring

● God känsla för foto, bild, grafiskt uttryck och visuellt innehåll

● Erfarenhet av bildredigering

● Mycket god förmåga att skriva säljande och inspirerande texter

● God svenska och engelska i tal och skrift

● Förståelse för hur man bygger ett starkt varumärke digitalt

● Förmåga att kombinera kreativitet med struktur, analys och affärstänk

Har du dessutom ett stort intresse för vintage, inredning, möbeldesign, arkitektur eller skandinavisk design kommer du sannolikt att trivas väldigt bra hos oss.

Vi söker inte bara en administratör

Det är viktigt för oss.

Vi söker en person som kan se potentialen i Reformfurniture och vara med och utveckla den.

Du ska kunna titta på vår digitala verksamhet och tänka:

Hur gör vi det här bättre? Hur säljer vi mer? Hur når vi fler? Och hur bygger vi ett varumärke som även fungerar internationellt?

Du kommer få ett stort mandat att påverka hur Reformfurniture utvecklas digitalt framåt.

Om Reformfurniture

Reformfurniture arbetar med noggrant utvalda vintage- och designmöbler med stort fokus på skandinavisk och dansk design.

Hos oss möts handel, design, hantverk och återbruk. Möbler restaureras och får nytt liv i vår egen verksamhet innan de möter nästa generation kunder.

Vi har byggt upp en stark fysisk verksamhet och ett engagerat community kring vårt varumärke. Nu är ambitionen att ta nästa stora steg digitalt och göra Reformfurniture till en självklar destination även för kunder långt utanför Skåne och Sverige.

Tjänsten

Omfattning: Heltid

Plats: Lund

Anställning: Heltidstjänst

Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse

Det här är en roll för dig som vill vara med och bygga något, inte bara förvalta det som redan finns.

Ansökan

Skicka CV och en kort presentation av dig själv.

Vi vill gärna att du berättar om tidigare e-handelsprojekt du arbetat med, vilka resultat du varit med och skapat samt vad du tror att du skulle kunna göra med Reformfurniture digitalt.

Har du portfolio, exempel på webbshoppar, fotografering, content eller andra relevanta projekt får du gärna skicka med dem.

Välkommen till Reformfurniture – och till nästa kapitel i vår digitala resa.

Perk (formerly TravelPerk) is the intelligent platform for travel and spend management. Built to tackle the time-consuming, manual work that gets in the way of real work, our tools automate everything from travel bookings to expenses, invoice processing, and more. By eliminating this shadow work that wastes hours, erodes morale, and saps innovation, we're on a mission to power real work, with real impact.

We're trusted by more than 12,000 companies worldwide, including On Running, Breitling, and Fabletics, and we're tackling the 7 hours of lost productivity per employee each week, a $1.7 trillion problem.

Founded in 2015, Perk has grown into a global company of more than 1,800 people across 12 offices globally, with headquarters in London and Boston. We combine innovation, control, and simplicity to transform how businesses work and how people feel at work.

At Perk, we're driven by our values, like being an owner, delivering a 7-star experience, and working as one team. We value curiosity, purpose, and mindset, not just knowledge, to unlock the power in your potential. Our talent team brings together leading minds from the travel, fintech, and SaaS industries, representing over 70 countries. If you're excited about having a real impact and shaping how millions of people experience work, we'd love you on the team.

Visit www.perk.com to learn more.

Business Automation Engineer

As part of the Customer Care Service Design team, a Business Automation Engineer is responsible for identifying operational inefficiencies and transforming manual processes into scalable, automated solutions that improve how our teams work.

He/She leverages a combination of workflow automation, data platforms, cloud technologies, and emerging AI capabilities to build reliable solutions that reduce manual effort, improve operational consistency, and enable Customer Care teams to scale efficiently.

Working closely with stakeholders across Customer Care, Product, Engineering, and other business functions, the Business Automation Engineer translates operational challenges into practical automation opportunities and delivers solutions using our supported technology stack, including Make.com, Airtable, Amazon Web Services (AWS), Zendesk, and emerging AI-powered tools.

Their work alternates between supporting the day-to-day stability of our tooling ecosystem and delivering roadmap initiatives that improve operational efficiency, automation maturity, and user experience.

What You’ll Do

Build and maintain automation solutions

  • Design, develop, test, and deploy automations that eliminate manual work and improve operational efficiency.

  • Maintain and enhance existing automations, integrations, and workflows to ensure reliability and scalability.

  • Troubleshoot issues and provide ongoing support for deployed solutions.

Translate operational needs into technical solutions

  • Partner with stakeholders to understand pain points, process gaps, and operational challenges.

  • Convert business requirements into clear automation designs and implementation plans.

  • Balance speed, simplicity, and long-term maintainability when designing solutions.

Leverage our automation and AI ecosystem

  • Build solutions using supported enterprise platforms including Make.com, Airtable, AWS, Zendesk, and approved AI technologies.

  • Explore opportunities to incorporate AI capabilities and intelligent automation where they can improve operational outcomes.

  • Support experimentation and validation of new technologies that could increase automation maturity across the organization.



Support strategic initiatives

  • Contribute technical expertise to roadmap projects and cross-functional initiatives.

  • Collaborate with Tooling, Operations, Product, and Engineering teams to deliver automation solutions aligned with business objectives.

  • Help ensure solutions are documented, maintainable, and scalable.

Success Looks Like

  • Manual effort is reduced through reliable automation.

  • Solutions are adopted and valued by internal users.

  • Automations require minimal ongoing maintenance after deployment.

  • Operational inefficiencies are proactively identified and addressed.

  • Roadmap initiatives are delivered successfully and sustainably.

  • AI and automation opportunities are evaluated pragmatically and implemented where they provide measurable value.

AI at Perk
AI is embedded in how we work across every function. The tools you'll use day-to-day are AI-enabled so you can move faster and spend more time on the work that matters. In practice, that means using AI to research and prioritise accounts, draft and refine outreach, handle customer interactions more effectively, synthesise information, and cut through shadow work - the invisible tasks that pull people away from the work only they can do - so you can focus on relationships and outcomes.

How We Work

At Perk, we take an IRL-first approach to work, where our team works together in-person 3 days a week. As such, this role requires you to be based within commuting distance of our hubs. We fundamentally believe in the value of meeting in real life to improve connectivity, productivity, creativity and ultimately making us a great place to work.

For certain roles, we can help with relocation from anywhere in the world, English is the official language at the office. Please submit your resume in English if you choose to apply. Do not forget to submit an updated portfolio and/or resume.

Perk is a global company with a diverse customer base, and we want to make sure the people behind our product reflect that. We’re an equal opportunity employer, which means you’re welcome at Perk regardless of how you look, where you’re from, or anything else that makes you, well, you.

Protect Yourself from Recruitment Scams

All official communication from Perk will always come from email addresses ending in @perk.com or @externalperk.com, our verified social media channels, or recruiters listed on our official LinkedIn page. We will never ask you to pay for equipment, training, or fees, request sensitive personal information such as bank details early in the process, or communicate through unofficial apps like WhatsApp, Telegram, or Signal. jobs.title: Product Support Analyst I
jobs.description:
Company Description

We’re Checkout.com. You might not know our name, but companies like eBay, Spotify, Klarna, Uber, and Sony do, because we’re behind many of the digital experiences you use every day.


We are where the world checks out, enabling over 10 billion transactions yearly for more than one billion global shoppers.

Whether you want to book a holiday, order food, renew a subscription, or check out online, there’s a good chance our tech powers the payments behind the scenes. Our platform helps the most ambitious businesses deliver effortless digital experiences, at scale.

If you want to do career-defining work, you’ve come to the right place. We move fast, think globally, and believe great teams are built by hiring exceptional people with conviction, curiosity, and the desire to make an impact.

With 20 offices across six continents and London as our HQ, we’re shaping the future of fintech – and we’re just getting started.

The ideal candidate holds a degree in Computer Science, Technology, Engineering, or a related field, although equivalent professional experience will also be considered. Candidates should have at least two years of experience in technical support, ideally within Fintech, Banking, Financial Services, or another technically complex environment.

Ideal candidates will have hands-on experience supporting gateways and card processing, troubleshooting APIs and integration errors, investigating logs and data, and diagnosing transaction issues. They should be able to interpret technical evidence, identify patterns, and apply a structured approach to problem solving. Strong communication skills are essential, as the role involves managing complex merchant enquiries and collaborating effectively with internal stakeholders.

The merchant is always at the centre of our work. We are looking for people with experience in, and a genuine desire to work in, customer support, helping merchants remove blockers and improve their results. Successful candidates demonstrate ownership, a strong sense of urgency, technical curiosity, and a commitment to quality. Comprehensive payments training will be provided, so prior payments experience is not required where the candidate has a strong technical support and troubleshooting foundation.

The Team

Merchant Product Support is a specialised global technical support function that sits between frontline support and specialist Product or Engineering teams in the ticket flow. Our analysts are product specialists aligned to defined Checkout.com product areas and features. They work closely with Product and Engineering to identify recurring issues, improve product functionality, and strengthen the support experience for each product area.

The team is primarily centred in London, with a strategic regional presence in Dublin, Mexico, Dubai, and Shanghai. This distribution provides broad coverage across multiple time zones and enables specialised support for merchants and internal teams.

We are passionate about technology and use state-of-the-art AI capabilities to create better outcomes for our customers. We look for people who are curious, open to new ways of working, and eager to use AI as builders from the outset. Team members are encouraged to develop and improve AI-enabled tools that make technical investigations more effective and help accelerate solutions.

Role Overview

The Analyst I is the foundational specialist tier within Merchant Product Support. The role receives and manages merchant and internal requests across channels such as instant messaging, email, and web forms. Analysts acknowledge requests, investigate and resolve issues within their product scope, apply documented technical procedures, provide clear updates, and work in line with agreed SLAs and quality standards. When an issue requires deeper expertise, they engage the appropriate internal team or escalate to an Analyst II or Senior Analyst with clear evidence and relevant troubleshooting details.

Troubleshooting is at the core of the role. Analysts investigate payment flows, system logs, transaction data, and other technical evidence to diagnose issues, identify recurring patterns, and understand emerging trends. Areas of investigation may include advanced financial investigations, payment transaction anomalies, REST API and integration errors, webhook failures, Vault and tokenisation issues, authentication, fraud detection logic, gateway and card processing issues, platform errors, and changes in payment performance or authorisation rates. The team also supports issues affecting payment methods such as PayPal, KNET, Klarna, SEPA, MB WAY, WeChat Pay, Alipay, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.

This is a specialist role supported by targeted training designed to build deep expertise in payment flows and enable consistently high-quality problem solving. Analysts use advanced tools and techniques for technical investigation and API debugging while developing the knowledge required to resolve issues efficiently and help merchants maintain successful payment operations.


Core Responsibilities

  • Ticket Management: Acknowledge and administer tickets assigned via the ticketing system; remain logged in and active during working hours.

  • Customer Support: Acknowledge, investigate, and respond to merchant inquiries via the ticketing system, as well as internal stakeholders who engage Merchant Care for technical assistance.

  • Investigation & Escalation: Perform initial investigations; refer complex concerns to Analyst II, Senior Analysts, or Level 3 teams as appropriate.

  • Knowledge Management: Resolve tickets using the existing knowledge base, identify documentation gaps, request new SOPs, and keep documentation updated.

  • Product Expertise: Maintain a solid understanding of products, services, and policies to provide accurate information.

  • Quality Assurance: Comply with the quality assurance framework to minimize errors and provide consistent care.

  • Issue Identification: Categorize global queue issues and identify repetitive problems, escalating the likely root causes to the wider team.

  • Process Improvement: Report procedural problems and participate in feedback loops with Product and Engineering teams.

  • Product Onboarding: Actively participate in training for new products and provide feedback on process gaps to project groups.

Additional Information

Bring all of you to work

We create the conditions for high performers to thrive, through real ownership, fewer blockers, and work that makes a difference from day one.

Here, you’ll move fast, take on meaningful challenges, and be recognized for the impact you deliver. It’s a place where ambition gets met with opportunity, and where your growth is in your hands.

We work as one team, and we back each other to succeed. So whatever your background or identity, if you’re ready to grow and make a difference, you’ll be right at home here.

It’s important we set you up for success and make our process as accessible as possible. So let us know in your application, or tell your recruiter directly, if you need anything to make your experience or working environment more comfortable.

Life at Checkout.com

We understand that work is just one part of your life. Our hybrid working model offers flexibility, with three days per week in the office to support collaboration and connection.

Curious about what it’s like to be part of our team? Visit our Careers Page to learn more about our culture, open roles, and what drives us.

For a closer look at daily life at Checkout.com, follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram

About us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.

What you'll be doing

As our FinCrime AML/CTF Manager, you'll lead, grow, and manage our 1st line AML/CTF operations team, translating compliance policies into smooth, actionable risk management processes across the entire customer lifecycle.

Here's what that looks like in practice:

  • Customer Risk Management - Owning and maintaining the Customer Risk Assessment Frameworks, ensuring risk scoring and categorisation accurately reflect financial crime realities.

  • Lifecycle & Periodic Reviews - Leading periodic and event-driven reviews across the customer portfolio to dynamically reassess customer risk categorisations.

  • Oversight of Due Diligence Activities - Overseeing onboarding and ongoing monitoring activities executed by KYC and KYB teams, aligning internal controls with regulatory expectations.

  • Product Requirements & UX Optimisation - Partnering closely with Product teams to define actionable onboarding requirements that balance regulatory compliance with a frictionless user experience.

  • Surveillance & Detection Management - Overseeing end-to-end transaction monitoring for all AML/CTF typologies, including timely assessments, escalations, and scenario calibrations.

  • Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management - Mentoring and scaling a team of AML/CTF analysts, driving operational excellence, and regularly reporting risk metrics to senior management.

  • Compliance Translation - Acting as the primary liaison to the 2nd Line Compliance team, proactively translating regulatory updates into scalable operational workflows.

  • Reporting to the FIU - Serving as the final 1st line approver for Suspicious Activity Reports (SARs) and Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs).

  • Audit & Regulatory Liaison - Preparing operational documentation and data for internal audits, external regulatory reviews, and inquiries from competent authorities.

Who we're looking for

This role needs someone equipped with strong leadership, deep regulatory mastery, and an operational mindset to protect our ecosystem against financial crime.

  • Experience - 6+ years in AML/CTF operations within Fintech, digital banking, or payment processing environments, with 2+ years of experience leading and managing dedicated teams.

  • Regulatory Knowledge - Profound understanding of EU AML Directives and FATF recommendations, with strong knowledge of Luxembourg regulatory requirements (knowledge of Italian regulations is a plus).

  • Certifications - Professional certification such as CAMS, ICA, or equivalent is highly expected.

  • Operational Framework Mastery - Proven track record managing transaction monitoring systems, reviewing/approving SARs/STRs, and designing practical customer risk-rating frameworks.

  • Stakeholder & Communication Skills - Exceptional ability to negotiate, collaborate across functions, and liaise seamlessly with 2nd line compliance teams.

  • Data-Driven Leadership - Strong analytical mindset capable of leveraging KPIs and data tools (such as HEX, SQL, or Splunk) to optimize operational queues and assess resource needs.

  • Change Management Mindset - Agility to lead teams through hyper-growth, shifting regulations, and tech upgrades while maintaining high morale and performance.

Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world.

Fra dag 1 har hovedfokuset vært kvalitet, faglig kompetanse i alle ledd, tilgjengelighet og miljø. Vi utfører månedlige kvalitetskontroller for å sikre at vi leverer på høyt nivå. Våre ansatte bli kontinuerlig kurset gjennom interne kurs, slik at vi er sikre på at de har høy kompetanse ut til våre kunder. Som serviceleder hos oss vil du være Trøndervasks representant og ansikt ut til våre kunder.

jobs.title: Trygghetsstrateg till Kinda kommun
jobs.description:
Vi söker nya kollegor!
Vill du jobba med människor, påverka andra människors liv och göra skillnad är Kinda kommun stället för dig. Här bryr vi oss om varandra och det är alltid nära till kollegor, chef och medborgare. Vi står inför en spännande framtid och vill fortsätta ge service med hög kvalitet till våra medborgare. Därför vill vi att alla medarbetare ska se möjligheterna, både i det lilla och i det stora. Här arbetar vi med värdegrunden framåtanda, ansvarskänsla och dialog. Den är med oss i det dagliga arbetet, hur vi bemöter varandra och de vi arbetar för, medborgarna.

1 plats(er).


Vill du vara med och skapa ett tryggare och mer motståndskraftigt Kinda?

Vi söker en trygghetsstrateg till kommunens trygghets- och säkerhetsavdelning. Här får du en bred roll där du arbetar både strategiskt och operativt med trygghet, brottsförebyggande arbete och beredskap (Säkerhet).

Som trygghetsstrateg är du ett kommunövergripande stöd och driver arbetet tillsammans med våra verksamheter och externa samverkansparter. I en mindre kommun är vägen från idé till handling kort – du får både utveckla arbetssätt och vara med och omsätta dem i praktiken.

Ditt uppdrag

Du kommer bland annat att:

    leda och samordna kommunens brottsförebyggande arbete, inklusive kommunens BRÅ, och representera Kinda i regionala sammanhang
    samordna förebyggande arbete inom bland annat SSPF, ANDTS
    samverka i arbete runt folkhälsa, suicidprevention och krisstöd
    utveckla arbetet mot välfärdsbrott och med frågor kopplade till PDV
    medverka i arbetet med civilt försvar samt risk- och sårbarhetsanalyser (RSA)
    följa relevant lagstiftning och bidra till att kommunens arbete uppfyller aktuella krav
    ta fram planer, riktlinjer och rutiner samt utbilda och stödja chefer och medarbetare
    samordna trygghetsskapande insatser tillsammans med kommunens verksamheter, myndigheter, föreningsliv och andra aktörer.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som har relevant utbildning eller erfarenhet av liknande arbete inom kommunal förvaltning eller annan offentlig verksamhet. Du har god förståelse för trygghets-, säkerhets- och brottsförebyggande arbete och är van att självständigt driva frågor från analys och planering till genomförande och uppföljning.

Du uttrycker dig väl i tal och skrift och känner dig bekväm med att presentera, informera och utbilda andra. För att lyckas i rollen behöver du också ha lätt för att samarbeta, skapa förtroende och göra komplexa frågor begripliga och användbara.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet inom ett eller flera av områdena BRÅ, SSPF, ANDTS, suicidprevention, välfärdsbrott, PDV eller RSA, civilt försvar och krisberedskap.

Hos oss får du

En bred och utvecklande roll med stora möjligheter att påverka. Du arbetar nära kommunens verksamheter och får vara med och utveckla Kindas förmåga att förebygga brott, skapa trygghet, hantera risker och bygga ett mer motståndskraftigt samhälle.

Tjänsten kommer säkerhetsklassas

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare, tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse.
