jobs.title: Ph.D.-scholarship in numerical optimisation of wind assisted propulsion systems
jobs.description:
Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, has a vacancy for PhD Research Fellow in numerical optimisation of wind assisted propulsion systems

Western Norway University of Applied Sciences (Høgskulen på Vestlandet, HVL) has an open Ph.D. position with a project period of 4 years at the Department of Mechanical Engineering and Maritime Studies. The Ph.D. candidate will be part of an interdisciplinary project involving three research groups on energy and environmental technology, on wind, water and waves and on data science. 

Due to the nature of the work to be carried out in the project, the candidate will be a part of the Ph.D.-programme Computer Science: Software Engineering, Sensor Networks and Engineering Computing. (https://www.hvl.no/en/research/phd-programmes/phd-programme-in-computer-science/). The research programme in Computer Science currently includes 20 professors and associate professors, more than 30 PhD and post-doctoral fellows, and a large number of master’s students.

This programme is located at the Faculty of Technology, Environmental and Social Sciences at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences. PhD research fellows receive an annual work expense funding which can be used for conference participation, research visits, and equipment.

Workplace will be at HVL Campus Bergen.


Tasks and areas of responsibility:

Wind Assisted Propulsion Systems (WAPS) are moving from demonstration to commercial scale. Rotor sails and rigid wing sails are currently installed on tankers, bulkers, and Ro-Ro vessels, and a growing number of wind-cargo ships are being purpose-built for sail propulsion. Sails reduce the ship’s onboard energy demand, and with it fuel consumption and emissions.


This PhD project will develop simulation and optimisation methods for modern sail design based on the Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM) and Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) as part of the optimisation loop. The developed method will be applied to optimise both existing sail technologies and novel concepts depending on ship size, route, and operation in order to determine fuel and emission savings.
 

The project will extend an existing Julia LBM in-house code, with established HPC LBM frameworks as references, benchmarks, and potential building blocks combined with Bayesian optimisation.

As part of the required duties (25% of the position), the candidate will join the team focusing on regional development at the faculty and the department. This might include:


• Promote more externally funded research projects in collaboration between our research environment and the shipping industry.
• Interact with regional, national and international partners, and work to promote cooperation between the department and the surrounding society (e.g., bachelor and master theses).
• Mobilization to promote research-based innovation in the shipping industry in collaboration with our participation in the project FORREGION Vestland.
• Supporting the department in our work related to lifelong learning in the shipping industry, with emphasis on strengthening the portfolio of flexible and decentralized education.


Qualifications (requirements):

•Admission to the PhD programme requires that the applicant holds a master’s degree in computer science or a closely related field, such as a master’s degree in informatics, software engineering, communication systems, engineering computing, scientific computing, or computational engineering.
•Candidates from other natural sciences or engineering disciplines holding a master’s degree with a strong emphasis on ICT and computing, for example mechanical, marine or aerospace engineering, applied mathematics or computational physics, may also qualify for admission to the PhD programme.
•Admission into the programme requires that the applicant has obtained strong grades for both the master’s thesis and the course work of the master’s degree. Specifically, admission into the programme normally requires that the applicant has obtained:
- a grade of B (Norwegian/ECTS scale) or better on the master’s thesis,
- an average grade higher than C (Norwegian/ECTS scale) on the coursework associated with the master’s degree
•Documented programming skills beyond scripting in Julia, or in a language Julia can call (Python, C, C++, Fortran).

The PhD research fellow must enrol in the PhD programme in Computer Science: Software Engineering, Sensor Networks and Engineering Computing at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, and must meet the formal admission requirements for admission into the PhD programme. The position is announced for a period of 4 years with 25% of the 4-year period will be designated to duties such as teaching, development and administrative tasks.

The PhD candidate will be assigned two academic supervisors at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences. An application for enrolment should first be submitted after an appointment is made and the supervisors will help with this procedure. The candidate must be enrolled as a PhD student within 3 months from the start of the employment.


Favoured qualifications (not requirements):

- Master’s thesis in computational fluid dynamics, ideally applied to wings, foils, rotors, or similar configurations.
- Knowledge of and experience with Lattice Boltzmann Method (LBM), Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) and/or Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD)
- Knowledge of and experience with optimisation methods.

 

Personal abilities:

- Ability to contribute towards a good work environment and in teamwork.
- Excellent communication skills, ability to communicate well in both written and spoken English. Proficiency, written and spoken, in a Scandinavian language is an advantage.
- The candidate must be diligent and display the ability to work independently, supplemented with regular guidance, and is expected to carry out high-quality research and to publish the results in international workshops, conferences, and journals.

 

Candidates who have submitted a master’s thesis and who have not yet been awarded a master’s degree may also qualify for the position, provided that the master`s degree is awarded within four weeks of the deadline for applications to this position. Proof of successfully finishing the master’s degree along with the grade for the thesis and the final average grade must be submitted to HVL as soon as possible. Applicants already holding a Ph.D. are not eligible for this position.


In addition to the required educational and scientific background, the following criteria will be evaluated: competence and grades on completed course work, quality of the master's thesis, publications (if any), research and teaching experience, practical software engineering skills and experience. A possible outline of a research plan for a potential PhD project will also be taken into account.

The PhD candidate will be assigned two academic supervisor(s) at Western Norway University of Applied Sciences. The necessary application to join the Ph.D. programme Computer Science: Software Engineering, Sensor Networks and Engineering Computing must be submitted and accepted within 3 months of starting in the position. The supervisors will help with this procedure.


Western Norway University of Applied Sciences is subjected to the regulation for export control system. The regulation might be applied in the processing of the applications.


For more information, contact: Associate Prof. Norbert Lümmen: Norbert.Lummen@hvl.no 


Application procedure:

Applications will be evaluated by an expert panel of three members.

Applicants are asked to submit their application and CV online. Please use the link “Apply for this job” (“Søk stillingen”).

The following documentation must be uploaded as an attachment to the online application:


•A brief cover letter including a description of research interests and motivation for working within the current project. The cover letter should include a detailed justification of your qualifications in relation to the listed requirements.
•CV (summarizing education, positions and a complete list of academic publications)
•Master thesis
•Transcripts and diplomas of bachelor’s and master’s degrees. If you have not yet completed your master’s degree, please submit a statement from your institution confirming the expected date of award of your master’s degree.
•Diplomas and certificatesAt least one letter of recommendation preferably from a previous academic supervisor.
•Names and contact details of 2 references. One of these should be the main supervisor of the master’s thesis.

At least one letter of recommendation preferably from a previous academic supervisor.

In case the applicant already has publications, a complete list of these and copies of up to five selected publications should be uploaded. Applicants should indicate which of these publications or parts of these publications should be given special consideration in the evaluation.

If the documents submitted are not in a Scandinavian language or in English, the applicants must submit certified translations of these. The transcripts must specify the topics, the course works, and the grades at the bachelor`s and master`s degree levels. It is required that the applicant encloses a recognition document showing that their degree is equivalent to a Norwegian bachelor’s degree, master’s degree, or PhD. You can read more about applying for recognition of foreign higher education here.

The Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir) offers an automatic recognition document for certain degrees from selected countries. If the applicant’s degree is covered by the automatic recognition, it will be sufficient to attach this document. Read more about automatic recognition here.

As the HK-dir application process may take some time it is recommended to apply to HK-dir as soon as possible. If you have not received a recognition document from HK- dir within the  application deadline, please enclose documentation from HK-dir showing that they have received your application.

Applicants should note that the evaluation will be based on the documentation submitted electronically via Jobbnorge within the submission deadline. The applicants are responsible for ensuring that all the documentation is submitted before the closing date. It is of utmost importance that all publications to be considered in the evaluation are uploaded as an attachment with the application, since these are sent electronically to the expert panel. Applications cannot be sent by e-mail or to individuals at HVL.

Applicants may be called in for an interview.


Salary:
  • Good occupational pension, insurance and loan schemes from The Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Exciting academic environment with the possibility of competence enhancement and development
  • Opportunities for training within the working hours 

The Research Fellow position is compensated according to position code 1017 Research Fellow.

There is a compulsory 2 % deduction to the pension fund (see http://www.spk.no for more information). The successful applicant must comply with the guidelines that apply to the position at any time.


General information:

The appointment will be made in accordance with the regulations for State employees Law in Norway ("Lov om statens ansatte)". Organizational changes and changes in the duties and responsibilities associated with the position must be expected.

State employment shall reflect the multiplicity of the population at large to the highest possible degree. Western Norway University of Applied Sciences Bergen has therefore adopted a personnel policy objective to ensure that we achieve a balanced age and gender composition and the recruitment of persons of various ethnic backgrounds.

Information about the applicant may be made public even though the applicant has requested not to be named in the list of applicants. The applicant will be notified if his/her request is not respected.

Short-listed applicants will be called in for an interview.

Employed on condition that you are granted a work and residence permit (must be considered individually).

Western Norway University of Applied Sciences is subjected to The Export Control Regulation. The regulation will be applied in the processing of the applications. 


Inclusion, challenging norms, collaboration

https://www.hvl.no/en/research/phd-programmes/phd-programme-in-computer-science/


Om arbeidsgiveren:

Høgskulen på Vestlandet (HVL) er en av de største høgskolene i landet, med om lag 1 800 tilsette og 16 000 studenter fordelt på fem campus i Førde, Sogndal, Bergen, Stord og Haugesund. Hvert år uteksaminerer vi 3000 kandidater som er med på å løse viktige samfunnsoppgaver.


HVL har sterke og innovative fagmiljø innen helse- og sosialvitskap, ingeniør- og maritime utdanningar, lærer-, kultur- og idrettsfag, natur- og samfunnsvitskap, og økonomi og ledelse. HVL skal være tett på arbeidslivet, regionen og studentene. Den overordnet ambisjonen vår er å bli et universitet med en tydelig profesjons- og arbeidslivsrettet profil.


HVL sin visjon er "Kunnskap som bygger menneske og samfunn". Strategiske ambisjoner og mål har særlig oppmerksom på berekraftig samfunnsutvikling, velferd og innovasjon, forankret i våre verdier - inkludere, utfordre og samhandle - som kjennetegner identiteten og kulturen hos oss.


 Fakultetet for teknologi, miljø- og samfunnsvitskap har et bredt utdanningstilbud både på bachelor og masternivå innenfor ingeniør- og naturfag, økonomiske og administrative fag, maritime fag, samfunnsvitskap og humaniora, i tillegg til phd-utdanninger i datateknologi, ansvarlig innovasjon og regional utvikling og i nautiske operasjoner.

Fakultet har fem institutt med om lag 500 tilsette og 5700 studenter. Fakultetet blir ledet av dekan som har det overordnet ansvaret for den faglige og administrative virksomheten ved fakultetet og som rapporterer til rektor. Hoveddelen av fakultetet sin virksomhet er i Haugesund, Bergen, Sogndal og Førde, men fakultetet har også aktivitet ved campus Stord.


Institutt for maskin- og maritime studium har om lag 900 studentar og 80 tilsette i Bergen og Haugesund. Instituttet har ansvaret for fagtilbud innen maritime utdanninger, maskinfag, marinteknikk, bærekraftig produksjon og sirkulærøkonomi og energi- og havteknologi. Havrommet er en fellesnemnar - sammen med fagfelt som samhandling mellom mennesker, organisasjon og teknologi (inkludert system), framtidas utfordringer i blant annet grønn omstilling, og økt digitalisering og autonomi i maritim og marin sektor. Instituttet har syv bachelorprogram, to masterprogram og ph.d.-i Nautiske operasjoner. Det er flere mulige veier til gjennomgående utdanninger fra bachelor til ph.d. i instituttet.

jobs.title: Power System Physicist/Engineer for the CMS HGCAL
jobs.description:
What you'll do
As Power System Physicist/Engineer for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter (HGCAL), you will play a key role in the development, integration, testing and commissioning of the power systems for one of the most innovative particle detectors ever conceived.

Working within a multinational, multidisciplinary team, you will contribute to the procurement and testing of power supplies for HGCAL detector modules, including low-voltage, high-current supplies for the readout electronics and medium-voltage supplies of up to 800 V for sensor biasing.

You will also contribute to the integration of power systems with the detector's safety, control and monitoring systems, as well as the testing and implementation of power components such as DC-DC converters, voltage regulation and cabling.

A key aspect of the role will be to assess the impact of the power system on HGCAL performance and to develop and implement strategies to minimise noise effects such as interference, coupling and ripple.

This role offers the opportunity to combine strong electrical engineering and detector-physics skills with hands-on involvement in the construction, testing and commissioning of a large-scale, state-of-the-art particle detector.

Your responsibilities
Follow the procurement of the power supplies (Low Voltage and Bias Voltage, totalling several MCHF), including carrying out acceptance and stress tests on the delivered units.
Support the commissioning of these power systems during the mass assembly and testing phases of HGCAL.
Work with physicists and engineers to evaluate the performance of HGCAL in relation to its power systems and to develop and implement mitigation strategies where possible and necessary, first on the surface and subsequently when HGCAL is installed in CMS, 100 metres underground.
Work with the HGCAL and central CMS Technical Coordination teams to oversee the installation and testing of the power systems underground in the "Service" and "Experimental" caverns. This will include overseeing cable installation, in-situ connectorisation where needed, testing and commissioning, and the integration of the power system into the HGCAL and CMS safety and monitoring systems.

Your profile
Strong track record in testing, operating and debugging power systems for complex devices, such as particle detectors used in high-energy physics experiments.
Experience with silicon- and/or scintillator-based particle detectors would be an advantage.
Experience with large-scale procurement of electronic systems, such as power supplies.
Ability to work successfully and efficiently within multinational, multicultural teams of engineers, scientists and technicians would be an advantage.
Master's Degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills
Construction, test and installation of power electronic components and systems.
Specification and follow-up of technical aspects of a contract.
Testing and validation of detector components.
Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
Assimilates large quantities of information, identifies key issues and formulates conclusions clearly and concisely.
Works well in groups and readily fits into a team; participates fully and takes an active role in team activities.
Has a structured and organised approach towards work; is able to set priorities and plan tasks with results in mind.
Ensures that information, procedures and decisions are appropriately documented.
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

jobs.title: rdinator for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter
jobs.description:
What you'll do
As Field Coordinator for the CMS High-Granularity Calorimeter (HGCAL), you will play a key role in coordinating and overseeing the assembly, integration, testing and commissioning of one of the most innovative particle detectors ever conceived. Working within a multinational, multidisciplinary team, you will help coordinate the mass assembly and testing of HGCAL detector elements ("cassettes") on the surface, their integration into the complete 250-tonne detector, and the subsequent system-level testing.

You will also contribute to the installation and commissioning of HGCAL approximately 100 metres underground within CMS, including the integration and testing of essential services such as CO? cooling, dry gas, cabling and optical fibres. This role offers the opportunity to combine strong technical coordination skills with hands-on involvement in the construction and commissioning of a large-scale, state-of-the-art particle detector.

Your responsibilities
Oversee the operation and maintenance of the HGCAL assembly and testing facilities at CERN, which include large ISO 7 cleanrooms and a large assembly hall. These areas are equipped with high-power electrical and cooling infrastructure that must be operated continuously and safely. You will be responsible for planning and organising the execution of all interventions in these facilities.
Provide technical support to physicists, engineers and technicians using these facilities. This will include liaising with the HGCAL Technical Coordinators and Safety Officer, as well as with the central CMS Technical Coordination team and CERN service groups (e.g. HVAC, electrical infrastructure, etc.).
Plan and supervise all activities related to the large-scale detector integration, including cassette insertion (Hadronic section of HGCAL - CE-H) and stacking (Electromagnetic section - CE-E), the mechanical and electrical connection between CE-E and CE-H, installation and testing of the HGCAL thermal screen (to maintain the exterior at a warm temperature while the interior is cold), and cold testing of the complete detector.
Work with the HGCAL team to plan and execute tests of "sectors" of HGCAL on the surface, and similarly when HGCAL is installed inside CMS.
Work with the HGCAL Engineering Team to ensure the safe transport of large and delicate HGCAL structures around the site, as well as the overall lowering of HGCAL into the experimental cavern.
Oversee logistics for HGCAL-related items, including detector modules, cassettes, ancillary equipment and mechanical components.

Your profile
Strong track record in planning and coordinating facilities for the assembly and testing of complex devices, such as particle detectors.
Demonstrated experience in the assembly and testing of particle detectors, particularly those based on silicon sensors, would be an advantage.
Familiarity with project planning tools such as Merlin and MS Project.
Proven ability to work successfully and efficiently within multinational, multidisciplinary teams of engineers, scientists and technicians.
Master's Degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Applied Physics, Mechanical Engineering or a related field.

Your skills
Operation and maintenance of electromechanical equipment and systems.
Operation and support of experimental facilities.
Organisation, planning and control.
Testing and validation of detector components.
Adapts quickly and resourcefully to shifting priorities and requirements.
Coordinates activities and focuses team on goals and objectives; monitors progress of team towards agreed goals and takes corrective action when needed.
Takes initiative beyond regular tasks and makes things happen.
Anticipates obstacles; assesses alternative solutions in order to have a fall-back plan.
Objectively assesses and monitors own work; regularly reports on progress and advises of any changes in schedule or priorities.
Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.

Field Service Managerina toimit asiakkaidesi luotettuna kumppanina puhtaanapitoon, hygieniaan ja laiteratkaisuihin liittyvissä asioissa. Vastaat oman alueesi asiakkuuksista ja työskentelet tiiviisti asiakkaiden kanssa varmistaaksesi, että he hyödyntävät Ecolabin ratkaisuja parhaalla mahdollisella tavalla.

Työssäsi vierailet säännöllisesti tunnettujen pikaruokaravintolaketjujen toimipisteissä, koulutat asiakkaita tuotteiden, laitteiden ja toimintatapojen parissa sekä autat heitä ylläpitämään korkeita hygienia- ja laatustandardeja. Vastaat oman alueesi asiakkuuksien kehittämisestä sekä tunnistat aktiivisesti myynti- ja lisämyyntimahdollisuuksia. Rakennat pitkäaikaisia asiakassuhteita ja autat asiakkaita löytämään heidän tarpeisiinsa sopivimmat ratkaisut. Tehtävääsi kuuluu myös annostelulaitteiden ja muiden laiteratkaisujen käyttöönottoja, asennuksia sekä huoltotoimenpiteitä. Lisäksi huolehdit tarvittavasta raportoinnista sekä osallistut oman vastuualueesi toimintatapojen ja palveluiden kehittämiseen.

Työsuhde on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen, ja se solmitaan alkuun Biisonin kanssa. Työ on liikkuvaa ja itsenäistä kenttätyötä, jossa suurin osa työajasta kuluu asiakkaiden luona. Vastuualue kattaa koko Suomen, mutta työ painottuu erityisesti Etelä-Suomeen. Matkat ovat pääosin päiväreissuja, mutta toisinaan työ edellyttää myös yöpymistä. Kotimaan asiakastyön lisäksi tehtävään voi kuulua satunnaista työskentelyä myös ulkomailla, esimerkiksi Keski- ja Etelä-Aasiassa. Asiakaskäyntien ulkopuolella voit työskennellä joustavasti etänä tai Helsingin Pasilan toimistolla.

**Mitä me etsimme?**

Etsimme henkilöä, joka viihtyy asiakasrajapinnassa ja nauttii itsenäisestä työskentelystä. Sinulla on vähintään muutaman vuoden työkokemus asiakaslähtöisistä ja vastuullisista tehtävistä. Taustasi voi olla esimerkiksi ravintola-alalta tai muulta palvelualalta, kenttämyynnistä tai vastaavista asiakasrajapinnassa olevista tehtävistä. Aiempi kokemus erityisesti pikaruoka- tai ravintolaympäristöstä auttaa tehtävässä onnistumisessa, sillä tällöin ymmärrät asiakkaiden toimintaympäristöä ja arjen vaatimuksia. Arvostamme myös myynnillistä ajattelutapaa, kykyä rakentaa luottamuksellisia asiakassuhteita sekä halua ottaa vastuuta omasta alueestasi.

Toivomme, että sinulla on käytännönläheinen ote tekemiseen ja valmius osallistua myös laitteiden käyttöönottoihin, asennuksiin ja huoltoihin. Sinun ei tarvitse olla tekninen asiantuntija, mutta käytännönläheinen ote, näppäryys työkalujen kanssa ja halu oppia uutta auttavat sinua menestymään tehtävässä.

Tehtävä vaatii matkustamista, joten voimassa oleva ajokortti ja oma auto ovat välttämättömiä. Toivomme hakijan olevan Etelä-Suomen alueelta, mutta sijainnista voidaan keskustella oikean hakijan kohdalla. Edellytämme sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa sekä hyvää englannin kielen taitoa. Venäjän kielen osaaminen vähintään perustasolla on eduksi.

Työssä onnistumista tukevat oma-aloitteinen ja ratkaisukeskeinen työote sekä kyky tehdä päätöksiä itsenäisesti. Olet helposti lähestyttävä, luotettava ja yhteistyökykyinen persoona, joka rakentaa pitkäjänteisiä suhteita asiakkaiden kanssa.

**Miksi meille?**

Tarjoamme sinulle vakituisen tehtävän kansainvälisessä ja vakaassa markkinajohtajayrityksessä, jonka tuotteita ja palveluita käytetään päivittäin tuhansissa ravintoloissa ympäri maailmaa. Saat tehtävään kattavan perehdytyksen, tukea kokeneilta kollegoilta sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi kansainvälisessä ympäristössä. Toimit osana pohjoismaista tiimiä, jossa osaamista jaetaan aktiivisesti. Työ tarjoaa paljon vapautta ja vastuuta, sillä suunnittelet pitkälti itse omat työpäiväsi ja aikataulusi.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Mikäli mielenkiintosi heräsi, kuulemme sinusta mielellämme lisää. Laitathan hakemuksesi linkin kautta mahdollisimman pian, kuitenkin 30.9.2026 mennessä. Aloitamme haastattelut jo hakuaikana ja valinta tehdään heti oikean henkilön löydyttyä.

Rekrytointiprosessi toteutetaan yhteistyössä Biisonin kanssa. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa rekrytointikonsultti Nea Repo, **nea.repo@biisoni.fi.**

jobs.title: Software Engineering Productivity Lead
jobs.description:
We are looking for a passionate technologist to lead the ways of working across all of Bittium groups software development: about 300 developers building everything from firmware to web frontends. You will set the standard for how we build, review, test, document and ship software, and roll it out hands-on with the teams. You get real authority, direct access to R&D leadership and backing from group management.

You might be the person who

- argued the team into a better merge strategy, and was right.
- tried the new build tool the weekend it came out.
- replaced a team's creaking toolchain with something modern, and nobody wanted to go back.
- has been told no about a rewrite more than once.
- moved into a lead, architect or managerial role years ago and never stopped writing code or tinkering with the pipelines.
- has rolled a new way of working out across several teams, and knows the hard part was never the tooling.

If a couple of these sound like you, keep reading. Whether you are a senior engineer ready to take your first step into leading and owning change beyond your own team, or a leader who has done this before and still wants to get your hands dirty, this role is built for you.

What you will own

- You define what modern software engineering means at Bittium: the standard every team builds against, and you keep raising it as the industry moves.
- You set our group-wide engineering workflow: version control strategy, branching, code review and CI/CD, from commit to release, with room for what each product and team needs and built for agentic-first development.
- You decide the quality bar a release has to clear: what we require from test automation, documentation and review before software ships.
- You author an engineering handbook with our senior engineers: a practical guide to how we build software, clear enough that any team can pick it up and use it.
- You help shape how we measure engineering health.

Product teams choose the right technology for their product. You are the engineers' engineer: you define, and help build, the engineering infrastructure and ways of working they stand on: pipelines, quality gates, test and documentation tooling, ready to use and maintained like products. Adoption is supported, not dumped on the teams. The work does not end with the first rollout. The foundation keeps evolving, and you keep pushing it forward.

Your first six months

- Help write the first version of our engineering handbook: a practical guide to how we build software, in one place.
- Set the group's ways of working, starting with source control and CI/CD, with the first teams already building on it.
- Get the first shared pipeline, quality gates and documentation tooling live with real teams. Working, not a slide deck.
- Put the first release quality gates into production use.

Where we are headed

Our goal is simple: well-tested, well-documented software, built on a shared, modern development platform. Software development is shifting toward agentic workflows, and we want our codebases ready for that: modular, containerized and verifiable, so an agent can check one out, build it, run the tests and trust the result. You define what that readiness means in practice, together with our Head of AI. We are also investing heavily in hardware-in-the-loop test automation against real devices, and your standards set the bar there too.

What we ask

- A software engineering background strong enough to hold your own with our senior engineers.
- A track record of changing how teams work, whether as the engineer who pushed for better Git workflows and modern tooling and made it stick, or as the lead who ran that change across an organisation.
- Strong opinions and dirty hands. You prototype, build and fix things yourself, and you lead the change at the same time: you own the direction, carry it through and answer for the outcome.
- You know modern DevOps and the engineering platform behind it well: version control, CI/CD, test automation, developer documentation.
- Agentic software development has clicked for you. You work with coding agents daily, you see where this goes as agents take on whole tasks with less and less supervision, and you have opinions about what that demands from codebases, tests, environments and documentation.
- You can work across very different stacks. Ours include, among other things, C/C++, Python, TypeScript/Node.js, web frontends, embedded Linux and FPGA.
- Fluent Finnish and good English.
- Due to the nature of Bittiums business and our customers expectations, you are a Finnish citizen and able to pass security clearance conducted by the Finnish Security Intelligence Service (SUPO).

We do not count years of experience. Skill, will and passion decide.

What we offer

- Group-wide authority over engineering standards.
- Deep technology with real stakes, from military radios in national defence to ECG monitors in hospitals.
- Room to stay hands-on. Prototype, experiment, pick the best tools. IT supports the infrastructure.
- Hybrid work in Oulu, our headquarters software site, or Espoo. Flexible inside Finland. Competitive pay.

Interested?

Send us your application as soon as possible. We will begin interviewing candidates during the application period.

About Bittium

Bittium specializes in the development of reliable, secure communications and connectivity solutions leveraging its 40-year legacy of expertise in advanced radio communication technologies. Bittium provides innovative products and services, customized solutions based on its product platforms and R&D services. Complementing its communications and connectivity solutions, Bittium offers proven information security solutions for mobile devices and portable computers. Bittium also provides healthcare technology products and services for biosignal measuring in the areas of cardiology and neurology. Net sales in 2025 were EUR 119.3 million and operating result was EUR 19.4 million. Bittium is listed on Nasdaq Helsinki

jobs.title: PhD Research Fellow in remote sensing of the cryosphere
jobs.description:
About the position

We invite applications for position as PhD Research Fellow in remote sensing of the cryosphere at the Department of Geosciences, Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences.

Starting date as soon as possible.

The fellowship period is three years.

A fourth year may be considered, and it will involve 25 % of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This is dependent upon the qualifications of the applicant and the current needs of the department.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo.
Place of work is department of Geosciences, Oslo.


Job description

The position is affiliated with the Department’s Section for Physical Geography and Hydrology, which has long-term experience in investigating the terrestrial cryosphere and is involved in various high-level research projects and centers. (See for instance http://www.mn.uio.no/geo/english/about/organisation/geohyd and https://www.mn.uio.no/geo/english/research/groups/remotesensing). We are a growing, lively, friendly and collaborative research environment in cold regions sciences, in particular in glaciology, remote sensing, geohazards, hydrology and geomatics. We participate in a number of international projects such that the successful candidate will have excellent opportunities to participate in international research networks. We also run an advanced drone lab on behalf of the entire faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences (https://www.mn.uio.no/geo/english/research/about/infrastructure/facilities/observations/geosciences/the-drone-infrastructure-laboratory/).

The position is embedded in a network of projects that involve remote sensing of the cryosphere and related data science methods: 

  • the European Research Council (ERC) Synergy Grant SnowShifts with University of Oslo (Prof. A. Kääb), EPFL Sion and WSL/SLF (Prof. M. Lehning), and BOKU Vienna (Dr. F. Koch) as PI institutions, and GFZ Potsdam, CESBIO Toulouse and ANavS Munich as further key partners. (https://cordis.europa.eu/project/id/101224858) 
  •  the SchmidtSciences project MountAInWater (lead: F. Pelliciotti, ISTA, and W. Immerzeel, Utrecht, and further PIs from Canada, Singapore, Netherlands, Switzerland, Norway and Germany.  (https://www.schmidtsciences.org/view/#modal-mountainwater-water-from-the-mountains-global-reanalysis-and-future-tipping-points) 
  • various ESA projects including Glaciers_CCI, Permafrost_CCI, Karakoram Anomaly, and the forthcoming EarthExplorer 10 mission Harmony. (https://climate.esa.int/en/projects/, https://climate.esa.int/en/Cross_ECV_Projects/ , https://www.esa.int/Applications/Observing_the_Earth/FutureEO/ESA_selects_Harmony_as_tenth_Earth_Explorer_mission)

The candidate will develop and apply cutting-edge remote sensing or photogrammetry methods, in combination with data science approaches such as machine learning and data assimilation via cryospheric models. A main focus of this work is snow and glaciers in the mountains around the globe. Candidates with relevant prior research experience in these areas will therefore be given preference. The candidate will have ample opportunities to collaborate internationally with other world-leading research environments and space agencies, and for field work in mountain environments and the Arctic.

The exact focus of the position and its primary project affiliation will be developed together with the successful candidate. 


What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in in geomatics, geosciences, computer science/data science/statistics, physics, mathematics, environmental sciences, geophysics or similar. Candidates must have submitted and defended their Master’s degree before the starting date.
  • Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Must document a strong quantitative background and interest in one or several remote sensing and data science approaches.  
  • Must document scientific programming skills, specifically for data processing and analysis of large datasets.
  • Evidence of creativity and capability of independent research.
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.

Desired qualifications:

  • It is an advantage if the required remote sensing or photogrammetry experience is within satellite-based observation of Earth surface processes, using optical, radar or lidar methods.
  • Good knowledge about cryospheric and mountain processes.
  • Previous experience with data assimilation and numerical modeling will be regarded as positive in the selection process.
  • Experience in automated processing of large data volumes. 
  • Experience with scientific publishing is regarded as beneficial.
  • Interest and willingness for, or experience with, field work in high-mountain/cold environments is an advantage. 

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:
    https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:
The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

For more information see:

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 

UiO is subject to the Security Act, which governs the organisation's protection of security-sensitive objects and knowledge, in addition to other relevant legislation concerning access to and handling of sensitive information. Based on this, it is a requirement that successful applicants are security-eligible. We may use background checks as part of our recruitment process.


What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • You share our genuine enthusiasm for the cryosphere, and the technologies and methods to observe and understand its changes
  • You are a person who prefers being present at work and actively contributes to the professional and social environment you are a part of
  • You are able to work both independently and as part of a team
  • You look forward to work in an interdisciplinary and international scientific environment

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.


We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • A pleasant and stimulating work environment.
  • Good welfare schemes.
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours.
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities.
  • Career development programmes.
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes.
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities.
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.

We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. 

We hope you will apply for the position with us.


How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter - statement of motivation and research interests
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications)
  • Copies of the original Bachelor and Master’s degree diploma and transcripts of records
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

Application with attachments must be submitted via our recruitment system Jobbnorge, click "Apply for this job".
Foreign applicants should attach an official explanation of their University's grading system.

When applying for the position, we ask you to retrieve your education results from Vitnemålsportalen.no. If your education results are not available through Vitnemålsportalen, we ask you to upload copies of your transcripts or grades. Please note that all documentation must be in English or a Scandinavian language.


General information

The best qualified candidates will be invited for interviews.

Applicant lists can be published in accordance with Norwegian Freedom of Information Act § 25. When you apply for a position with us, your name will appear on the public applicant list. It is possible to request to be excluded from this list. You must justify why you want an exemption from publication and we will then decide whether we can grant your request. If we can't, you will hear from us.

Please refer to Regulations for the Act on universities and colleges chapter 3 (Norwegian), Guidelines concerning appointment to post doctoral and research posts at UiO (Norwegian) and Regulations for the degree of Philosophiae Doctor (PhD) at the University of Oslo.  

The University of Oslo has a transfer agreement with all employees that is intended to secure the rights to all research results etc.


Om arbeidsgiveren:

The University of Oslo is Norway’s oldest and highest rated institution of research and education with 26 500 students and 7 200 employees. Its broad range of academic disciplines and internationally esteemed research communities make UiO an important contributor to society. 

The geosciences are the studies of the planet Earth and its comparative planetology; the atmosphere, the hydrosphere and cryosphere, the Earth's surface and its interior. The Department of Geosciences conducts research and teaching in most of the domains of geoscience; geology, geophysics, physical geography, geomatics, hydrology, meteorology and oceanography. The Department is the broadest geoscience research and education environment in Norway. We perform research at a high international standard and have five ERC (European Research Council) research projects ongoing.

The Department encompasses six scientific sections; Meteorology and Oceanography, Geography and Hydrology, Study of sedimentary basins, Environmental geosciences. and Crustal Processes. We host now a third in the line of three Centre of Excellences:  PHAB – Centre for Planetary Habitability, and have a Norwegian Research School for PhD students (Research School for Dynamics and Evolution of Earth and Planets, DEEP).

The Department aims to contribute to the new and important UN Sustainability Development Goals, and are important contributors to IPCC (UN’s Inter-governmental Panel on Climate Change). The staff consists of 40 professors and associate professors, in addition to postdoctoral fellows, PhD students, researchers, technical- and administrative staff. The Department has around 200 employees.

jobs.title: Project Engineer – Vaasa
jobs.description:
About the role

In this position, you will become part of a close-knit and experienced team of experts. We are looking for a long-term addition to the team: someone for whom this role offers an inspiring next step in their career, and who wants to thrive and grow in the position for years to come.

What We Offer You
- Salary: Approximately €2,800 – €3,500/month depending on your experience and background.
- A long-term career path: We offer a role where you are invested in and where you can genuinely deepen your professional skills over the long term.
- Responsibility and freedom: Once you prove your skills, you will have the freedom to independently drive your projects to completion.
- Comprehensive support: Although we expect an ability to work independently, you will not be left alone. Your supervisor and a team of top professionals will support your success, especially during the onboarding phase in the first few months.

Work tasks

Your role is not pure design work in front of a screen; instead, you will act as a dynamic technical coordinator. Working as the Project Manager's right hand, you will be responsible for the technical success of energy plant lifecycle upgrades and automation retrofits in accordance with contract specifications.
- Guide and supervise design work, review electrical and automation drawings, and ensure the technical correctness of procurements.
- Act as a knowledgeable link between designers, logistics, subcontractors, and international customers.
- Depending on the size of the projects, you may manage several (max. 10) smaller automation upgrades simultaneously or extensive plant retrofit projects (from foundations up to the MV side).

What We Are Looking For

In this role, technical theory alone is not enough; you need a professional approach and strong drive to push things forward. You are no longer a complete beginner—you have already gained valuable experience and now want to take on broader responsibility.

To succeed in the position, we expect you to have:
- A solid professional foundation: You hold a relevant technical degree (e.g., Electrical or Automation Engineering, B.Sc. or M.Sc.) and previous work experience (e.g., a few years) in industry, commissioning, field service, or automation projects.
- The right personality: You are stress-tolerant and understand that the project world evolves daily. You are a proactive expert who also knows how to justify technical choices constructively and firmly.
- Language skills: Fluent spoken and written English is mandatory. Finnish language skills are considered a major asset in teamwork.

Vaasa is the Heart of This Role

This is a role where you grow into an expert and solve challenges together with the team on site. We strongly believe that the deepest expertise and best support are transferred most effectively when working alongside more experienced colleagues. Therefore, we expect you to work mainly at the Vaasa office. We are not looking for a remote worker for this position, but rather a team player who enjoys communal daily life on site. The position also includes occasional travel to global customer sites (estimated at approx. 30 travel days per year).

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our clients wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.

Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.title: BIM Coordinator, Granlund
jobs.description:
**Looking for a role where you can take ownership of BIM coordination in large-scale construction projects? We are now looking for a BIM Coordinator to join Granlund!**

**_Granlund_** _is a rapidly growing expert organization in the real estate and construction sector. Together with our clients and stakeholders, we are building a sustainable and intelligent future. Our more than 1,600 professionals serve across 30 locations throughout Finland._

**Would you be our new BIM Coordinator?**

As a BIM Coordinator, you will take responsibility for the technical coordination and quality assurance of BIM models across a variety of construction projects, including data center, commercial, and residential developments. Acting as the project's BIM expert, you will ensure that models meet project requirements and support smooth collaboration between all stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.

Your responsibilities include coordinating BIM activities, leading model review meetings, and ensuring the technical quality of BIM models throughout different project phases. You will also support designers and project teams with BIM-related questions and help ensure that project requirements are met consistently across all disciplines.

You will work closely with the Project Manager, who is primarily involved during the early phases of the project. As the project progresses, you will take primary responsibility for its technical responsibilities. You will typically work on several projects simultaneously, supporting Project Managers, designers, contractors, and clients throughout different project phases while acting as a key link between stakeholders.

The position is a full-time and permanent role, and you will be employed directly by Granlund. The role offers a highly flexible working model with the possibility to work remotely from anywhere in Finland. You may also work from any Granlund office according to your own preference. Occasional travel to project sites across Finland is expected as part of the role.

**What are we looking for?**

We are looking for a BIM professional who can work independently and confidently guide projects through BIM-related matters. You have at least two years of experience in BIM coordination and understand how construction projects progress from design through execution. Experience in commercial construction projects is particularly valuable, while experience in data center projects is considered an advantage.

A relevant educational background in construction or engineering is required. Strong Solibri expertise is essential for success in this role, while experience with Navisworks and Revit is a plus. BIM Coordinator certification is an advantage, but not required. Most importantly, you understand BIM processes and can ensure the technical quality of project models. You communicate fluently in both Finnish and English.

As a person, you are proactive, analytical, and comfortable taking responsibility for your work. You are able to work independently when needed, but also collaborate effectively with others. You have the confidence to raise issues, challenge assumptions, and communicate openly when challenges arise.

**Why join us?**

At Granlund, you will work in a company that has been a pioneer in Finnish building services engineering for decades. You will contribute to demanding and large-scale projects such as data centers and commercial environments, where your work truly matters. As one of the leading data center design and consulting companies in the Nordics, we offer long-term career opportunities in a rapidly growing field, where projects are becoming increasingly significant in scale and impact. You will have strong opportunities to grow and develop your expertise, with career paths that can be shaped around your strengths and interests.

We place real emphasis on employee well-being, continuous learning, and a supportive, professional work environment. You will be part of a collaborative and ambitious team where people take ownership, share knowledge, and work together toward common goals.

The monthly salary for this position is approximately 4000 euros, depending on the candidate's experience and skills.

**Are you interested?**

Could you be our new colleague? Please submit your application via the link either in English or Finnish as soon as possible, but no later than 25.9.2026. We will begin interviews during the application period.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. For more information, please contact Biisonis Recruitment Consultant Nea Repo (**nea.repo@biisoni.fi**).

jobs.title: Network Architect
jobs.description:
Are you an experienced network professional with a strong architectural mindset and passion for secure, resilient, and scalable network solutions?

**We are looking for a Network Architect** to take responsibility for the design, implementation, and strategic development of Outokumpus global network infrastructure.

**In this role**, you will ensure that our network solutions are aligned with business objectives, security standards, and future technology needs. You will provide technical guidance across network technologies and support both operational activities and transformation initiatives. **As a Network Architect**, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining the overall view of Outokumpus network architecture, covering areas such as LAN, WLAN, WAN, firewalls, external access, IP services, and cloud connectivity.

You will work closely with IT teams, business stakeholders, partners, and projects to define target architecture, guide solution design, and ensure that global network standards and technologies are followed.

**In this role, you will:**

- Develop and maintain the current Network Architecture view, covering LAN, WLAN, WAN, firewalls, external access, and IP services

- Define network standards, policies, and best practices

- Create, maintain, and drive short-term and long-term network roadmaps aligned with IT and business needs

- Develop and uphold the target Outokumpu Network Architecture, identifying gaps and improvement opportunities

- Support key partners in designing and implementing network solutions

- Guide IT programmes and projects towards the agreed target architecture

- Define and maintain consistent processes to ensure global technologies and standards are followed

- Identify and evaluate new technologies and innovations in the network market

- Own network documentation and develop processes for its review and lifecycle management

- Ensure network designs comply with security standards and regulatory requirements

- Design network solutions across cloud platforms


We are looking for a candidate with strong technical expertise, architectural thinking, and the ability to translate business requirements into practical, secure, and cost-effective solutions.

**To succeed in this role, you should have:**

- More than 7 years of experience in network technologies, solutions, and security

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in relevant field or equivalent experience

- In-depth knowledge of networking and network security concepts, protocols, and technologies

- Experience with traditional and cloud computing environments, including legacy technologies

- Experience with Microsoft Azure is considered an advantage

- Understanding of industry-specific production and OT environments

- Experience with Palo Alto and Aruba hardware and tools

- Ability to translate business requirements into cost-effective technical solutions

- Experience with Enterprise Architecture processes and tools

- Strong conceptual, functional, and technical skills

- Willingness and flexibility to travel based on business needs


**Why join us?** At Outokumpu, you will have the opportunity to work in an international environment and contribute to the development of secure, modern, and business-critical network services. You will play an important role in shaping the future of our global network architecture and supporting digital transformation across the company. If you are ready to take the next step in your career and make an impact in a global industrial environment, we would be happy to hear from you.

**Please submit your application and CV in English** before the 4th of October via our website.

**For more information about the role,** please contact Sam Kurdynowski, Head of Compute and Networks, Sam.Kurdynowski@outokumpu.com.

jobs.title: Projektmedarbetare till vårt arbete med barn och familjer
jobs.description:
Vi rekryterar en medarbetare till vårt team för förebyggande familjearbete i Pargas för perioden 1.10.26-31.7.27. Arbetets huvudsakliga uppgift är att arbeta inom projektet **Hav och Hem – föräldrafärdigheter för en trygg vardag och bättre barndom i skärgården**.

Vi erbjuder dig

- Ett intressant och mångsidigt arbete med fokus på att stärka föräldraskap, familjers välmående och barns uppväxtvillkor.

- Arbete är självständigt, men det finns ett mångprofessionellt team som du är del av.

- Varierande arbetsuppgifter.


**Vad är Hav och Hem?**

Hav och Hem är ett tvåårigt utvecklingsprojekt (1.8.25-31.7.27) som stärker föräldraskap, familjers resiliens och tillgången till stöd i Pargas och på Kimitoön. Projektet riktar sig till svensk-, finsk- och flerspråkiga familjer med barn i åldern 0–18 år samt till professionella som möter föräldrar i sitt arbete. Målet är att stärka familjers resurser i vardagen och bidra till en trygg barndom i skärgården. Projektet finansieras av Leadergruppen I samma båt rf och Svenska kulturfonden.

**I arbetet ingår att**

- genomföra individuell föräldrahandledning,

- planera och leda gruppverksamhet för föräldrar,

- samarbeta med professionella och aktörer i regionen,

jobs.title: Industrial Painter
jobs.description:
Industrial Painter Wanted for Give Steel A/S

Do you have experience with surface treatment of steel structures? Are you skilled in spray painting and using airless pump equipment? And do you thrive in a busy work environment where quality and safety are top priorities?

If so, Give Steel A/S is looking for an Industrial Painter to join our painting department in Brande.

You will become part of an international company specialising in the surface treatment of large steel structures. Our painting department operates 24/7 throughout the week, while your position will primarily be on the day shift.

Why Choose Us?

We continuously develop and improve our production processes and utilise modern equipment for surface treatment and fire protection coatings. You will have access to state-of-the-art facilities, including newly built paint halls with advanced ventilation systems and a new water-based paint application facility.

We prioritise a safe and positive working environment and value teamwork, mutual respect, and strong social relationships.

What Will Your Workday Look Like?

You will be responsible for spray painting steel structures using primarily airless pump equipment. We focus on using modern technology and equipment to support efficient production processes.

Safety is a key aspect of surface treatment work. You will therefore receive thorough training in safety procedures as well as the handling of waste materials and residues generated during the painting process.

Your Primary Responsibilities

You will work with:

  • Surface treatment of large steel structures.
  • Spray painting using primarily airless pump equipment.
  • Following established safety procedures.
  • Handling waste materials and residues from the surface treatment process.

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for a reliable and team-oriented employee with experience in the surface treatment of steel structures.

We imagine that you:

  • Hold a valid epoxy certificate.
  • Have experience with surface treatment of steel structures.
  • Have experience using airless pump equipment.
  • Thrive in a fast-paced work environment.
  • Work well as part of a team.
  • Speak and write either Danish or English.

What We Offer

  • Skilled and supportive colleagues.
  • A positive work environment with a strong focus on safety and well-being.
  • A workplace built on strong social values.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Canteen scheme and additional employee benefits.
  • Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.
  • Fitness facilities and massage services.

Practical Information

  • Working hours: Full-time position on the day shift.
  • Start date: As soon as possible.
  • Location: Give Steel A/S, Sjællandsvej 14, 7330 Brande, Denmark.

Would You Like to Join the Team?

If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact the Painting Department Team Leader, Kenneth Helmuth Thomassen,  +45 66 50 77 44

Please submit your CV and clearly state your relevant experience.

We are looking for someone who can start as soon as possible, and the job posting will be removed once the position has been filled.

About Give Steel A/S

Give Steel A/S is a manufacturing engineering and steel construction company specialising in the design, engineering, production, and installation of load-bearing steel structures and steel roof trusses.

Quality, safety, and documentation are integral parts of our daily work. We also focus on climate considerations, material selection, and documentation throughout both the engineering and production processes.

You will become part of an international company with strong technical expertise and excellent opportunities for professional development. Collaboration, responsibility, and integrity are key values in our everyday work.

jobs.title: Production Coordinator, Konecranes
jobs.description:
**We are now looking for a Production Coordinator to join Konecranes' global delivery organization and support customer delivery projects worldwide.**

_Konecranes moves what matters. We are a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with more than 16,000 professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs._

_Konecranes is committed to ensuring that all employees and job applicants are treated fairly in an environment free from discrimination and where diversity, equity and inclusion are valued._

**Would you be our new Production Coordinator?**

As a Production Coordinator, you will play an important role in ensuring that materials, information and deliveries move smoothly throughout customer delivery projects. Working as part of an international team, you will collaborate closely with colleagues in engineering, procurement, logistics, quality and project management to keep projects progressing according to plan. The role offers a unique opportunity to gain a broad understanding of how global delivery projects are executed from planning and procurement to final delivery.

Your daily work includes creating purchase requisitions in SAP, maintaining bill of materials (BOM) structures, coordinating shipments and supporting material availability throughout project deliveries. As projects evolve, new requirements and unexpected situations naturally arise. Your role is to keep things moving forward by coordinating activities, communicating with stakeholders and proactively resolving potential issues.

You will also work with technical documentation such as drawings and parts lists. While you do not need to be an experienced engineer, you should feel comfortable interpreting technical information and understanding how different components fit together within a project.

This is a full-time and permanent position. You will be employed by Biisoni and work on assignment at Konecranes. The role follows a flexible hybrid working model, combining remote work with regular weekly office days in Hyvinkää. Occasional international travel may be part of the role.

**What are we looking for?**

Whether you are a recent graduate or have already gained a few years of experience, this role offers an excellent opportunity to build expertise in project deliveries, logistics and supply chain operations within a global industrial company.

You may have gained experience through studies, internships or previous work in areas such as supply chain management, project coordination, logistics, production planning or procurement. A background in industrial engineering and management, mechanical engineering, logistics or another relevant field is beneficial, but we are primarily looking for motivation, learning agility and a proactive mindset.

To succeed in this role, you should have strong general IT skills and the ability to quickly learn new systems and tools. Strong communication skills in English are required, as English is the working language in this role. Additional language skills are considered an advantage.

As a person, you are organized, curious and solution-oriented. You enjoy coordinating multiple tasks, taking ownership of your work and finding practical solutions when plans change. You are comfortable working in a dynamic environment and collaborating with stakeholders from different backgrounds and cultures.

**Why us?**

This role offers a great opportunity to learn how global customer delivery projects and supply chains operate in practice. You will gain exposure to multiple business functions and develop valuable expertise while working alongside experienced professionals in an international environment.

At Konecranes, you will be supported by a collaborative team culture where questions are encouraged, knowledge is shared openly and colleagues help each other succeed. The role also provides excellent opportunities for future career development across the company.

**Have we got your interest?**

If you are interested, we want to hear from you as soon as possible! Please submit your application via the link by 30.9.2026. We process applications and start interviews already during the application period.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. For more information about the position, please contact Saija Salter, Recruitment Consultant via email at **saija.salter@biisoni.fi**

jobs.title: Senior Project Planner
jobs.description:
At Grid & Power Quality Solutions and Service business at Hitachi Energy in Europe (HBUEU), Inclusion drives our culture of innovation and collaboration. Our leading technology and strong market position enable us to achieve growth targets in the energy transition across current and growing market segments such as data centers, hydrogen and e-mobility.

Join Our Team!

Hitachi Energy is looking for a Senior Project Planner to join our Project Controls team within the Nordic Operating Unit of our Grid Integration business. The position is based in Vaasa, Finland or Västerås, Sweden, with hybrid working possibilities.

As a Senior Project Planner, you will play a critical role throughout the entire lifecycle of our most complex electrical substation projects, from tendering to project handover in the field of planning and scheduling. Your expertise and proactive approach will ensure consistency and alignment of scope, time, cost, and progress, ultimately contributing to the success and satisfaction of our customers.

In this role, you will be in the driving seat, ensuring projects have robust, dynamic, and well-structured schedules that meet contractual objectives and provide clear roadmaps for the execution phase.

In this role, you will be responsible for developing and maintaining robust, dynamic project schedules that align with contractual commitments and provide a clear framework for successful project execution.

You will work closely with various stakeholders making sure the project schedules are used for work coordination, predictable forecasting, proactive schedule risk management, cost management, resource management, and of course, team alignment. You will also conduct schedule and resource analysis and prepare schedule progress reporting materials both for external and internal purposes.

At Hitachi Energy, we know that great results are achieved together. As a Senior Project Planner, you will collaborate closely with Project Managers, Project Controllers, Lead Engineers, Project SCMs, Logistic Specialists, Site and Commissioning Managers and with our Customers. You will also become part of a highly experienced and supportive community of Project Planners. Together, we share knowledge, solve challenges, and support one another in delivering excellence in every project.

**How you'll make an impact**

· Take a leading role in planning and scheduling activities in complex projects and support project teams with schedule governance, analysis and decision making

· Develop, maintain, and analyze integrated project schedules in close collaboration with project teams

· Support predictable schedule forecasting by aligning time, cost, resources and progress

· Identify schedule deviations, risks, and opportunities early, and communicate them clearly to project stakeholders

· Prepare schedule reports and analyses, including S-curves, critical path analyses, resource histograms and On-Time-Delivery (OTD) milestones

· Actively communicate schedule information to stakeholders to keep everyone informed

· Support and prepare What-if schedule scenarios, delay mitigation plans and Extension of Time (EoT) claims together with the project team

· Promote planning and scheduling best practices across the organization, act as a role model and support less experienced planners

· Drive the use and continuous improvement of planning and scheduling methodologies and tools

**Your background**

· M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Electrical engineering or another relevant field

· Proven experience in planning and scheduling complex projects

· Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to engage, motivate, and inspire stakeholders across the project organization

· Advanced proficiency in Primavera P6 and good knowledge of schedule management theory

· The ability to prepare and maintain high quality, dynamic project schedules together with the project team

· A proactive and self-driven mindset, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability

· A structured and goal-oriented approach to your work, with a focus on delivering results

· Project Management Certificate (PMP® and/or PMI-SP®) is considered an advantage

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; knowledge of Finnish and/or Swedish is considered a plus

jobs.title: Safari Guide, Lapland Safaris Olos
jobs.description:
**Lapland Staff is looking for Safari Guides for various locations of Lapland Safaris for the winter season 2026–2027. We are looking for Safari Guides to work in Luosto, Levi, Saariselkä, Ylläs and Olos.**

As a Safari Guide, you get to introduce our international guests to the magnificent nature of Finnish Lapland and guide them through adventure activities. You may act as a guide, for example, on a snowshoe safari at the top of a fell, take the guests on a visit to a reindeer farm and a husky kennel, or snowmobile into the snowy forest to see the Northern Lights. In some of our destinations a part of safari guides job is to also guide various bus tours.

Your work tools can be snowmobiles, ice fishing gear, e-fatbikes, skis and snowshoes. As a guide, your workdays consist of preparing for the safari programs, meeting the guests before the safaris, as well as taking care of the clothing of your guests. You will help them dress up properly before each safari and after the activity you will take care of the clothes that you provided such as overalls, socks, boots and gloves. One of the most essential parts of the job is to help dress our guests with winter clothes, and all our safari guides work as part of our equipment team. After the safaris, cleaning and maintaining the equipment used on safaris is an important part of a safari guides daily routine as well. Whatever you do, every day you get to see the excitement on your guests faces as they prepare for new and unique experiences!

We are looking for people who enjoy being outdoors regardless of the weather and to maintain a positive attitude even on long and busy days. Your workdays are rarely the same, and a working day can consist of one or several different tasks, and a lot of work is also done in the evening. Changes to your daily tasks may come with short notice.

In addition to outdoor work, variation to your days comes from indoor clothing maintenance work. Work tasks and guest groups vary a little between destinations. The guides we are looking for are versatile and multi talented, with an open attitude towards different work tasks.

**In all our destinations,** knowledge of French language, is considered an advantage. We train our employees in first aid skills, but we value previously acquired first aid skills as well. At least a class B driver's license is an essential requirement for the job. BE driver's license and experience of driving a 9-seater vehicle in snowy conditions are considered advantageous, as well as knowledge of the area. **In addition, please note that in order to work in Finland, EU-citizenship/passport or valid working permit to Finland is required. Please read more under the job advertisement.**

**In Luosto,** the safari guides may act as elf guides during the Christmas season.

**In Luosto and Levi**, knowledge of French language (fluent) is a prerequisite.

**We expect from you:**

- Positive attitude and excellent cooperation and interaction skills

- Customer service-focused and group management skills

- Flexibility and ability to work under pressure

- Passion for outdoors and Interest in Finnish Laplands nature, culture and history

- Fluent English - knowledge of French, German, Italian or Spanish is considered an advantage


**We offer you:**

- Fun working days and a supportive team

- The opportunity to learn about the nature of the north

- Numerous leisure opportunities enjoying the real winter

- Comprehensive staff benefits of Lapland Hotels & Lapland Safaris. You will receive benefits for example from equipment rental, restaurants and Lapland Ski Resorts lift tickets.


Lapland Safaris provides for new employees a paid Arctic Guide -course at the beginning of their employment.

The employment relationship is a fixed term seasonal contract by the Collective Agreement in the Adventure Services sector. Work will start in November 2026 and will last until the end of March 2027, in Rovaniemi a few positions end already mid-January 2027. Salary according to the Collective Agreement of Adventure Services grade A-C, minimum hourly wage between 10,80-13,60 € (gross). Work will be done also during weekends and public holidays. Sundays and Finnish bank holidays are paid double. Accommodation is organized in shared rooms, with reasonable rent in comparison to the local price level.

Please note that Lapland Safaris is a non-smoking working place.

Interviews are conducted and hiring decisions are made already during the application period so apply soon!

More information: info@laplandstaff.fi

Read the job descriptions and the workday stories from HERE.
