jobs.title: Junior Structural Analyst
jobs.description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Vaasa, Finland/Trieste, Italy

Application deadline: 23.9.2026

Want to start your career in structural analysis and develop your FEM expertise through real engineering challenges? Wärtsilä is looking for a Junior Structural Analyst to join its Structural Analysis team!

**What will you be doing?**

As a Junior Structural Analyst, you will work with structural calculations and FEM analyses that support Wärtsiläs product and technology development. Your work will focus especially on cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems. You will perform and evaluate FEM analyses, prepare technical reports, and collaborate with designers and other specialists to turn analysis results into engineering decisions.

You will join an experienced Structural Analysis team where knowledge is actively shared. Your analyses and reports will be reviewed by experienced colleagues, giving you regular feedback and support. You are encouraged to ask questions, discuss different approaches, and learn from specialists working with demanding structural analysis challenges.

You will start with clearly defined calculation assignments and take on increasingly complex analyses as your skills develop. Over time, you can deepen your expertise in different component areas and contribute to simulation method development and new ways of working. **What makes you a great fit?**

You may be taking your first steps in structural analysis or already have some relevant experience and want to deepen your FEM expertise. Most importantly, you have a solid foundation in mechanics and FEM and the motivation to develop into a structural analysis specialist.

You enjoy solving technical problems and working with others, but you are also comfortable taking ownership of your own assignments. You communicate your findings clearly, actively look for solutions, and know when to ask colleagues for input.

**We expect you to have:**

- A relevant Masters degree in Mechanical Engineering, Technical Mechanics, or a related engineering field

- A good understanding of mechanics and the fundamentals of FEM

- Practical experience with FEM through studies, projects, internships, or work

- Good communication skills in English

- A proactive approach to learning, problem-solving, and teamwork


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience with Abaqus, Ansys, OptiStruct, Nastran, SimLab, HyperMesh, or similar simulation software

- Previous internship, summer job, or project experience related to structural analysis or mechanical engineering

- Interest in simulation method development, noise simulation, machine learning, digitalization, or other new analysis methods and tools

- Finnish or Swedish language skills


**Why join Wärtsilä?**

- Contribute to the development of Wärtsiläs marine technologies and solve engineering challenges shaped by an evolving industry.

- Work in an international R&D environment where structural analysis connects you with specialists across different engineering disciplines.

- Deepen your FEM expertise through real structural analysis challenges and gradually take on more demanding assignments.

- Learn alongside experienced specialists who review your work, share their expertise, and support your development.


**Practicalities:**

This is a permanent, full-time position, and you will be employed directly by Wärtsilä. The position can be based either in Vaasa, Finland, or Trieste, Italy, and follows Wärtsiläs hybrid working model. The starting date will be agreed upon with the selected candidate.

**Interested?**

Please submit your CV in PDF format in English or Finnish by September 23rd at the latest via aTalents application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/381526/create/. A motivation letter is optional, but with a role-specific motivation letter you can provide more information about your relevant skills and why this would be an interesting opportunity for you.

jobs.title: Structural Analysis Expert
jobs.description:
Type: Full-time, permanent

Location: Vaasa, Finland/Trieste, Italy

Application deadline: 23.9.2026

Looking for new challenges within structural analysis that go beyond routine simulations? Join Wärtsilä to solve complex engineering problems and shape how they are analyzed.

**What will you be doing?**

As an Expert in Structural Analysis, you will solve demanding structural strength and durability challenges using FEM and numerical analysis. You will perform, evaluate, and report simulations related to dynamics, fatigue, stress, and structural strength, supporting product and technology development across cylinder heads and valve mechanisms, fuel systems, and gas systems.

Your assignments will range from focused structural calculations to complex investigations where you identify the root causes of technical challenges and determine how to move forward. You will work closely with designers, component experts, and other technical specialists, using simulation and measurement data to support engineering decisions and solve real product development challenges.

Beyond individual analysis assignments, you will contribute to developing simulation methods, processes, and new ways of working. You will share your findings and expertise within the Structural Analysis team, helping others apply new methods and learnings in their work. Depending on your expertise and interests, you may also contribute to areas such as noise simulation, machine learning, and digitalization.

**What makes you a great fit?**

You already have several years of professional experience in FEM and structural analysis, combined with a strong understanding of mechanics and numerical analysis. You are comfortable taking ownership of demanding simulation assignments, evaluating results critically, and communicating your findings and recommendations to designers and other technical specialists.

You enjoy getting to the root of complex technical problems and finding practical ways forward. You work independently when needed but value collaboration, actively seek input from others, and are equally willing to share your own expertise and learnings with the team.

**We expect you to have:**

- Professional experience in structural analysis and practical FEM simulations, preferably involving engine components or other mechanically demanding products

- An MSc or PhD degree in Mechanical Engineering, Technical Mechanics, or a related engineering field

- Experience with Abaqus, HyperMesh, SimLab, OptiStruct, or similar simulation software

- Good communication skills in English

- A proactive and solution-oriented approach, with the ability to collaborate effectively across technical teams


**We consider as an asset:**

- Experience or interest in machine learning, digitalization, or data analytics

- Experience or interest in numerical noise analysis or noise simulation development

- Experience with CFD or multiphysics simulations

- Experience developing simulation methods, processes, or analysis tools

- Finnish or Swedish language skills


**Why join Wärtsilä?**

- Solve varied structural analysis challenges, from focused simulations to complex investigations requiring deeper technical analysis.

- Shape simulation methods and ways of working, giving you opportunities to influence how structural analysis is developed and applied.

- Apply your expertise to engineering decisions that directly support the development of Wärtsiläs marine technologies.

- Collaborate across an international R&D environment where experienced specialists actively share methods, findings, and technical knowledge.


**Practicalities:**

This is a permanent, full-time position, and you will be employed directly by Wärtsilä. The position can be based either in Vaasa, Finland, or Trieste, Italy, and follows Wärtsiläs hybrid working model. The starting date will be agreed upon with the selected candidate.

jobs.title: Rustfri Smed
jobs.description:
Rustfri smed

 

Er du erfaren indenfor rustfri svejsning ? Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis at være udlært smed – det vigtigste er, at du har praktisk erfaring og kan levere et godt stykke håndværk, og er en kompetent og alsidig håndværker, som har fokus på kvalitet. Vil du gerne indgå som et ansvarligt medlem af et team i en professionelt ledet virksomhed? Så er du måske én af vores nye medarbejdere.

 

Dine opgaver vil blandt andet bestå af:

  • Svejsning og bearbejdning af emner i rustfrit stål

  • Arbejde ud fra tegninger og arbejdsbeskrivelser

  • Kontrol af kvaliteten på de færdige emner

  • Samarbejde med kolleger om at få opgaverne sikkert og effektivt gennem produktionen

Har du også erfaring med aluminium, er det en fordel – men det er ikke et krav.

 

IQ Metal er i vækst, og for at møde vores kunders forventninger om leveringsfleksibilitet og -sikkerhed, har vi besluttet at øge antallet af medarbejdere og investere i en række nye maskiner. Du vil blive en del af et team med mere end 450 medarbejdere i IQ Metal, som samarbejder med store kunder i hele Europa. Vi leverer typisk samlede løsninger af produkter og fokuserer på at give kunderne den bedste oplevelse ved at sikre komplet levering til tiden, i rette kvalitet.

Kan du se dig selv i virksomheden?

Du indgår som en fast del af et godt team med 10-15 mand, som selv planlægger hverdagen og skaber overblik over ordreplanen. Vores maskinpark sikrer, at alt kører som det skal. En del af vores maskiner er fuldautomatiske, mens andre er semi-automatiske. Vi inviterer gerne på en kop kaffe og tur rundt i produktionen, hvis du er interesseret i et job hos os.

Vi tilbyder:

Løn og ansættelsesforhold er gode og konkurrencedygtige, og indeholder udover pension også en sundhedssikring. Alle fastansatte på nathold tilbydes årligt sundhedstjek. Der er kaffe og vand tilgængeligt i kantinen, og vi har en god stemning på virksomheden, som er professionelt ledet.

Kan du se dig selv i jobbet?

Vi tilbyder selvstændigt arbejde i moderne faciliteter. Det er et krav, at du er en erfaren smed, som har arbejdet inden for faget inden for de sidste par år. Du skal have tegningsforståelse, samt selv kunne udvikle og fremstille fiksturer og værktøjer til at sikre optimal håndtering af emner.

Vi forventer at du er en god kollega, som hjælper til når det er krævet af hensyn til teamet og opfyldelse af kunders forventninger. Du har humor og smil på læben i hverdagen, også når der er travlt. Bopæl nær Hasselager/Århus vil være en fordel, men ikke nødvendigvis et krav.

Interesseret?

Læs mere om virksomheden hjemmesiden www.iqmetal.com eller kontakt vores produktionsleder Lars Holm på telefon 8738 9036 for en uforpligtende og fuldt fortrolig snak. Ansøg ved at sende dit CV eller skriv lidt om din erfaring på: lh@iqmetal.com.

jobs.title: Sales & Business Development Manager
jobs.description:
Sales & Business Development Manager

Affix Scaffolding Europe Oy – Hyvinkää, Finland

Position: 1

Location: Hyvinkää, Finland

Start: As soon as possible, with operations expected to commence by the end of 2026 at the latest

Employment & compensation: Negotiable based on experience and profile

About the role

Affix Scaffolding Europe Oy is a newly established Finnish business preparing to launch its operations in Hyvinkää for the import, sales, rental, storage and logistics of professional scaffolding systems and related equipment.

Our Finnish operations are currently being established and are expected to commence by the end of 2026 at the latest.

We are looking for an experienced Sales & Business Development Manager to take a key role in building Affix's commercial presence in Finland and supporting further growth in selected European markets.

This is a newly created role in a new business operation, offering significant responsibility and the opportunity to shape the company's sales approach, customer acquisition processes, CRM setup and go-to-market activities from an early stage.

The successful candidate will be expected to actively develop new business, establish customer relationships, build and manage a sales pipeline, negotiate commercial terms and, most importantly, successfully close sales and rental agreements.

Main responsibilities

Identifying and developing new B2B customers and business opportunities.

Building relationships with construction companies, scaffolding contractors, industrial companies, equipment-rental businesses and other relevant customers.

Managing the full sales cycle from prospecting and first contact through meetings, quotations, negotiations and deal closing.

Developing and maintaining a structured sales pipeline and sales forecast.

Preparing commercial offers and actively following opportunities through to a decision.

Understanding customer requirements and proposing suitable scaffolding systems, equipment and commercial solutions.

Developing long-term customer relationships and identifying repeat-sales and cross-selling opportunities.

Supporting the company's market-entry and growth strategy in Finland and selected European markets.

Monitoring market developments, competitors, pricing and commercial opportunities.

Participating in customer visits, trade events and other relevant sales activities.

Coordinating with Affix's international manufacturing, sourcing, technical, operational and back-office teams.

Helping establish scalable sales, CRM and growth-management processes for the Finnish business.

Required experience and skills

Applicants should have:

Proven B2B sales and business-development experience.

Demonstrated experience in negotiating and successfully closing commercial deals.

Relevant sales experience in scaffolding, construction equipment, industrial products, building materials, equipment rental or another comparable B2B sector.

Ability to independently develop new customer relationships and manage the complete sales process.

Strong commercial, negotiation and relationship-management skills.

Experience using leading CRM platforms, such as Salesforce, HubSpot, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Pipedrive or comparable systems.

Experience using modern sales, prospecting, pipeline-management or growth tools to support lead generation, customer development and sales performance.

Ability to establish structured CRM practices, maintain high-quality pipeline data and use sales information for forecasting and decision-making.

Good understanding of quotations, pricing, commercial terms and customer account development.

Professional-level Finnish and English communication skills.

Ability and willingness to travel for customer meetings when required.

A proactive, target-oriented and highly independent approach to work.

Language skills

As Affix is developing an international European business, applicants should preferably speak at least one additional European language in addition to Finnish and English.

German or French is particularly valued. Other relevant European language skills are also considered an advantage.

Considered an advantage

Existing network within the Finnish construction, scaffolding, industrial or equipment-rental sectors.

Experience selling or renting scaffolding systems or related construction equipment.

Knowledge of Ringlock, Cuplock or other modular scaffolding systems.

Experience launching or developing a new market, business unit or customer portfolio.

Experience building sales processes and CRM structures for a new or rapidly growing business.

International B2B sales experience.

Experience in outbound sales, account-based sales, lead-generation platforms or other modern growth-management approaches.

Experience working with manufacturing, sourcing and back-office teams located outside Finland.

Experience in Nordic, German-speaking or French-speaking markets.

What we offer

This is an opportunity to join Affix Scaffolding Europe Oy at the beginning of its Finnish operations and play a central role in building the company's commercial foundation.

The successful candidate will have significant influence over customer acquisition, sales processes, CRM practices, commercial strategy and future growth.

The form of cooperation and compensation package can be negotiated according to the candidate's experience, track record and preferred level of responsibility. Possible arrangements may include:

full-time employment with a fixed salary;

fixed salary plus performance-based commission or bonus;

another performance-oriented employment structure; or

for a particularly suitable and experienced candidate, a broader business-partner-style role may also be discussed.

The final arrangement will be agreed mutually based on the candidate's background and the needs of the business.

Vi er en del af Arla Foods Ingrediens, der er en uafhængig virksomhed i Arla Foods med ambitioner om at blive verdens førende leverandør af vallebaserede ingredienser til fødevareindustrien.

Har du styr på logistik og lager? Så bliv en del af Danmark Protein, hvor sikkerhed, medarbejdertrivsel og kvalitet ligger øverst på prioriteringslisten. Her får du mulighed for at bruge din faglighed inden for logistik og lager i et uformelt og stemningsfyldt arbejdsmiljø.

jobs.description:
Sydjydsk søger smed/klejnsmed til vores fabrik i Kolding tæt på motorvejen.

Vi er en familievirksomhed 4 generation, og vi har travlt. Derfor søger vi en smed.

 

Dine primære opgaver bliver:

·         Smedearbejde.

·         Klip, svejs, buk af jern og stål.              

·         Diverse forskellige forefaldende opgaver på værkstedet f.eks. boring og op-savning.

 

Dine kvalifikationer – vi forventer at du:

·         Du er Smed og har erfaring med at svejse (TIG og/eller MAG).

·         Har nogle års erfaring, og brænder for at lave smedeopgaver.

·         Er i god fysisk form. Arbejdet er fysisk – vi står op hele dagen.

·         Er stabil og møder til tiden.

·         Er kvalitetsbevidst og samtidig effektiv.

·         Er struktureret, og kan bevare overblikket i en travl hverdag.

·         Kan arbejde både selvstændigt og sammen med andre – også med dem, der måske ikke har samme baggrund eller erfaring som dig selv.

·         Er åben og ærlig, og respekterer, at andre også er det.

·         Kendskab til svejsning i rækværk med tynde rør (1-2 mm) er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

 

Vi tilbyder:

·         En udfordrende dagligdag med højt tempo i et uformelt miljø.

·         Du bliver en del af teamet sammen med dygtige, erfarne og engagerede kolleger.

·         Mulighed for at udvikle dig, hvis du viser os initiativ, engagement og tager ansvar.

·         Arbejdstiden er 37 timer og lønnen fastlægges efter kvalifikationer.

 

Lyder det som noget for dig? Så send os din ansøgning og et CV.

Mærk din ansøgning i emne ”Medarbejder til Smed” og send den til job@sydjydsk.dk

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen er du velkommen til at sende en mail.

 

Vi ønsker at ansætte den rette kandidat snarest muligt, og indkalder løbende til samtaler. Søg derfor hurtigst muligt, hvis du er interesseret. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

jobs.description:
[https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/51a48aea-9cb3-42cf-8080-ca1ef36998cf/original.jpeg]


ASIAKKUUSPÄÄLLIKKÖ – HALUATKO TEHDÄ TULOSTA JA NÄHDÄ SEN MYÖS PALKASSASI?

Sytytkö tavoitteista, kaupoista ja onnistumisista? Oletko parhaimmillasi silloin, kun ympärillä tapahtuu paljon ja tilanteet vaativat nopeita päätöksiä?

Arsenaalissa pääset vauhdikkaaseen kaupalliseen rooliin, jossa yhdistyvät myynti, asiakkuudet ja ihmiset. Tässä työssä et jää odottamaan, että puhelin soi. Tartut itse mahdollisuuksiin, kontaktoit asiakkaita ja pidät huolen siitä, että oikeat työntekijät ja oikeat työtehtävät kohtaavat mahdollisimman tehokkaasti.

Arsenaali on luotettava, vakavarainen ja moderni henkilöstöpalveluyritys. Työllistämme päivittäin 250–300 rakennus-, kuljetus- ja ravintola-alan ammattilaista Uudenmaan alueella. Vuonna 2025 liikevaihtomme oli 10,9 miljoonaa euroa.

Nyt etsimme joukkoomme tavoitteellista ja energistä asiakkuuspäällikköä, joka haluaa tehdä tulosta – ja menestyä yhdessä muun joukkueen kanssa.


TÄSSÄ TYÖSSÄ TEKEMISELLÄSI ON SUORA VAIKUTUS TULOKSEEN

Asiakkuuspäällikkönä vastaat omista asiakkuuksistasi ja niiden kehittämisestä. Samalla pidät silmät auki uusille kaupallisille mahdollisuuksille.

Yksi tärkeimmistä tehtävistäsi on huolehtia henkilöstöpoolimme mahdollisimman korkeasta käyttöasteesta. Kun työntekijän toimeksianto päättyy, tavoitteena on löytää hänelle nopeasti seuraava työ. Kun asiakkaalle syntyy äkillinen tarve, meidän tehtävämme on ratkaista se.

Työpäivääsi kuuluu:

* aktiivinen myynti nykyisille ja uusille asiakkaille

* uusien asiakkaiden kontaktointi ja tapaaminen

* omien asiakkuuksien kehittäminen

* vapautuvien työntekijöiden aktiivinen tarjoaminen asiakkaille

* uusien työntekijöiden rekrytointi yhdessä rekrytointitiimimme kanssa

* työntekijöiden työvuoroihin ja toimeksiantoihin liittyvien asioiden hoitaminen

* nopeasti muuttuvien tilanteiden ratkaiseminen.

Työssä tulee vastaan päiviä, jolloin monta asiaa tapahtuu yhtä aikaa. Asiakkaan tarve muuttuu, työntekijä vapautuu ennakoitua aikaisemmin tai sovittu henkilö ei pääsekään töihin. Silloin etsimme ihmistä, joka ei jää ihmettelemään ongelmaa vaan miettii: miten tämä ratkaistaan?


TUNNISTATKO ITSESI?

Emme etsi ensisijaisesti tietyn toimialan osaajaa tai tietyn tutkinnon suorittanutta. Etsimme ennen kaikkea oikeanlaista draivia.

Saatat olla etsimämme henkilö, jos:

* haluat voittaa ja saavuttaa tavoitteesi

* saat energiaa kaupoista ja onnistumisista

* raha ja mahdollisuus vaikuttaa omaan ansaintaasi motivoivat sinua

* tartut puhelimeen mieluummin kuin jäät odottamaan

* pystyt tekemään päätöksiä nopeasti myös paineen alla

* osaat hahmottaa, missä on hyvä kauppa ja mihin ei kannata käyttää aikaansa

* olet järjestelmällinen ja tarkka, vaikka ympärillä olisi kiire

* uskallat olla jämäkkä asiakkaiden ja työntekijöiden kanssa

* epäonnistuminen tai muuttunut tilanne ei pysäytä sinua – siirryt nopeasti seuraavaan ratkaisuun

* olet energinen, ahkera ja nautit korkeasta tekemisen temposta.

Sinulla ei tarvitse olla kokemusta henkilöstöpalvelualalta. Kiinnostava taustasi voi löytyä yhtä hyvin esimerkiksi myynnistä, logistiikasta, kuljetusalalta, resursoinnista tai muusta nopeatempoisesta liiketoiminnasta.

Toivomme kuitenkin, että olet jo päässyt näyttämään kaupallista osaamistasi ja tiedät, mitä tavoitteellinen työskentely käytännössä tarkoittaa.

Emme etsi kaikkien miellyttäjää. Etsimme hyvää tyyppiä, joka tulee toimeen erilaisten ihmisten kanssa, mutta uskaltaa myös tehdä päätöksiä, pitää sovituista asioista kiinni ja viedä tilanteet loppuun.


MITÄ SAAT MEILTÄ?

Kun odotamme sinulta paljon, haluamme myös palkita onnistumisesta.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

* 2 500–4 000 euron suoritusperusteinen pohjapalkka plus bonus kuukaudessa – onnistuminen näkyy omassa palkassasi

* mahdollisuuden työsuhdeautoon

* vahvan perehdytyksen ja henkilökohtaisen mentoroinnin

* kokeneen rekrytointitiimin tuen

* osaavan ja kannustavan työyhteisön

* miellyttävät toimitilat hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella

* säännöllisen työajan arkisin klo 8–16 toimipaikassamme Helsingissä

Arsenaalissa tavoitteet ovat korkealla, mutta niitä ei saavuteta kyynärpäätaktiikalla. Tiimissäsi työskentelee muita asiakkuuspäälliköitä sekä rekrytoinnin ammattilaisia. Autamme toisiamme onnistumaan, ja kaupoista sekä hyvistä tuloksista iloitaan yhdessä.


HALUATKO NÄYTTÄÄ, MIHIN PYSTYT?

Jos haluat työn, jossa päivät kuluvat nopeasti, tulokset näkyvät konkreettisesti ja omalla aktiivisuudellasi on merkitystä sekä asiakkaalle, työntekijälle että omalle ansainnallesi, haluamme tutustua sinuun.

Emme etsi täydellistä CV:tä. Etsimme oikeaa asennetta, kaupallista vaistoa ja halua onnistua.

Ota seuraava askel ja osoita meille, miksi juuri sinä olisi hyvä vahvistus Arsenaalin joukkueeseen.

Jussi Tuisku

jobs.title: Assistant Professor in Operations and Supply Chain Digitalisation
jobs.description:
The Center for Supply Chain Digitalisation (CSD), at the Department of Technology and Innovation, University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for an Assistant Professor in Operations and Supply Chain Digitalization with special focus on simulation and/or artificial intelligence applied to operations and supply chains.

The targeted start date is February 2027.

The successful candidate will be responsible for collaboratively building up the area of operations and supply chain digitalisation with a primary focus on quantitative methods such as discrete-event and agent-based simulation, process automation, data science, and machine learning.

Successful candidates will drive internationally recognized and competitive research, work closely with industry, and are expected to attract external research funding. The position has a strong focus on experimental and applied research in production systems and supply chain fields. The candidate will play a key role in providing outstanding education, supervising bachelor's and master’s students, and developing junior research staff.

SDU CSD is a highly international group of faculty members, embedded in a region with a strong network of companies, including some of Denmark's largest global industrial players (i.e. Danfoss, Linak, Siemens) and many manufacturing SMEs. Projects currently run by the group cover a range of topics within the field of operations and supply chain digitalization.

The successful candidate must have a background in engineering. PhD degree preferably in industrial engineering, supply chain, operations management, operations research, or the like.

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

 

We expect

A highly motivated, collaborative person, who can work in an international, interdisciplinary team, with documented research skills in the field of operations and supply chain. The candidate needs to be a team player and, at the same time, be able to work independently. The successful candidate is active in publishing in engineering journals.

The ideal candidate can connect research with practical technology application and has demonstrated skills and competencies in one or more of the following areas:

  • Discrete-event and/or agent-based simulation

  • Artificial intelligence, machine/deep learning applied to operations and supply chain (AI-applications in other fields are not relevant for this position) 

  • Agentic AI applied to operations and supply chain

  • Business and intelligent process automation

Further information is available from Associate Professor Elias Ribeiro da Silva elias@iti.sdu.dk.

 

We offer

  • A professional workplace culture that values equality, mutual respect, and is designed to accommodate and encourage work-life balance

  • A vibrant social environment with structured activities and informal routines that promote cross-disciplinary interaction and cultivate an inclusive, supportive atmosphere.

  • An engaging, dynamic, and international interdisciplinary environment with extensive collaboration opportunities across national, international, and industrial partners

  • Opportunities for continued professional development and education for all staff members.

  • Access to a well-developed research infrastructure

  • A strong institutional commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion in all aspects of the workplace

 

About the workplace

The position is within the SDU Center for Supply Chain Digitalisation (CSD) at the Faculty of Engineering on the international campus Sønderborg. The center conducts research at the intersection of supply chain management, data science, and digital technologies. Our work applies quantitative, data-driven methods to analyse, design, and optimise complex supply chains.

In close collaboration with industry partners, the center focuses on the full data journey across the supply chain, developing tools and methods based on advanced analytics, simulation, and artificial intelligence to enable stronger coordination, end-to-end transparency, and more sustainable and efficient supply chain operations.

SDU CSD is situated in a region with a robust network of companies, including some of Denmark’s largest global industrial players as well as numerous SMEs. The group’s current projects mainly focus on building quantitative models and methods to support better decisions or on turning data-driven optimisation, simulation, and digital tools into practical use in operations. 

The SDU CSD is a highly international and interdisciplinary group of faculty members, with international students. The campus is in Sønderborg, an attractive coastal town with an open Scandinavian culture, and affordable housing and living costs.

 

Special benefits when working in Denmark

  • The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week

  • 30 days of paid holiday per year

  • The yearly salary for a full-time assistant professor is between DKK 502.905 and DKK 566.647 depending on the years of working experience. Postdoc experience may place you on a higher salary step. The salary includes a base salary, a position-related supplement and pension (18.07 %). Additional supplement(s) for special qualifications can be negotiated. Authorisation supplement(s) will be granted, if relevant for the position. Your local eligible trade union representative at SDU negotiates your salary on your behalf.

  • Subsidized preschool childcare and a free education system from primary school up to university level

  • Universal health insurance as a resident of Denmark, including family members officially residing in Denmark

  • In relation to childbirth, employees are entitled to a combined total of 52 weeks of parental leave, shared between parents, with full or partial salary depending on circumstances.

  • Researchers recruited from abroad are offered a special researcher tax scheme with a lower tax rate. 

  • Travel and moving expenses may be partially covered.

 

Living in Denmark

The International Staff Office (ISO) at SDU provides a variety of services for new employees, guests and people who consider applying for a job at the University of Southern Denmark. Among other things, the staff answers questions concerning salary, taxation, housing and accompanying family.

We recommend that international applicants also take the time to visit Work in Denmark.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

 

Application and assessment

Applications will be assessed by an expert committee. When the expert committee issues its assessment, applicants will receive the portion of the assessment pertaining to them personally.

The committee assesses candidates only based on the application materials. Please include the following documents in English: 

  • Brief motivation letter

  • Curriculum vitae

  • Full list of publications

  • Copies of the three publications on which the applicant wishes to be evaluated. Please attach one pdf-file for each publication

  • Diplomas/Certificates (Master and PhD degree)

  • Summary and documentation of teaching experience. You may attach a Teaching Portfolio.

  • Documentation of other qualifications relevant to the position

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

 

The application deadline is October 15, 2026, at 11.59 PM/23.59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Shortlisting may be used in the assessment process. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  An interview may be included as part of the overall evaluation of the applicant’s qualifications. If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support. Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply and specific faculty information for application at the Faculty of Engineering.

 

Employment terms

Appointment as an assistant professor is temporary and for an initial 3-year period. The preferred start date is from February 2027.

During employment, the assistant professor will complete the Lecturer Training Programme. 

Employment as an assistant professor requires academic qualifications at a minimum of PhD level at the time of employment. Network Engineer je klíčová pozice ve vztahu ke klientům Arelion a k NOC základně, provádějící definované úkoly v oblasti monitorování optické páteřní sítě a eskalačního řízení na pracovišti s nepřetržitým provozem ve směnném pracovním režimu, a to včetně fáze komplexní klientské podpory. Odborná způsobilost a požadavky: široké provozní zkušenosti s IP platformami (Cisco, Arista), mobilními daty a přenosovými technologiemi (fiber, xWDM) včetně dodavatelů jako Infinera a Ciena, prokazatelné technické know-how a dovednosti v oblasti odstraňování závad příslušných platforem (např. xWDM, TCP/IP, MPLS, BGP, QoS), úroveň výkonného uživatele operačních systémů Windows/Linux Server/Client, zkušenost s prací NOC nebo technické podpoře v mezinárodním telekomunikačním prostředí, zájem o softwarové nástroje a účast na iniciativách souvisejících s IT, plynulá angličtina na profesionální úrovni. Klíčová rozhraní: síťová rozhraní, včetně řízení závažných incident a výpadků, rozhraní pro zákazníky, s odpovědností za řešení incidentů souvisejících se službami, úzká spolupráce s ostatními provozními týmy. Téměř veškerá činnost je prováděna v anglickém jazyce.
Network Engineer is the key role in relation to Arelion clients and NOC base, performing defined tasks in fiber backbones network monitoring and escalation management at the workplace with uninterrupted service (24/7) in a shift working mode, including phase of comprehensive client support. Specific area of expertise, requirements: Solid operational experience with IP platforms (Cisco, Arista), Mobile Data, and Transmission technologies (fiber, xWDM) including vendors such as Infinera and Ciena Documented technical knowhow and skills in terms of troubleshooting per relevant platform (e.g. xWDM, TCP/IP, MPLS, BGP, QoS,) Power user experience on Windows/Linux Server/Client operating systems, Experience working in a NOC or technical support function within an international telecom environment, Interest in software tools and participation in IT-related initiatives, Fluent professional English. Key Interfaces: Network-facing, including major incident and outage management, Customer-facing, with responsibility for service-specific incident handling, Close collaboration with other operational teams. Almost all activities are done in English.

jobs.title: Premium Support Engineer (London, Weekend)
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

As a Premium Support Engineer at Replit, you’ll be the front line for our highest-value customers — delivering fast, expert, and reliable technical support when it matters most. You’ll handle complex product issues, guide customers through critical incidents, and ensure every interaction meets the highest standard of quality and speed.

Replit is at the forefront of AI-driven software development, and how we support customers is constantly evolving. You’ll play a critical role in shaping how Premium Support adapts to new products, new customer expectations, and AI-assisted workflows, operating effectively in ambiguity and driving clarity for your team.

You’ll combine deep technical troubleshooting with calm, confident communication to keep builders moving — whether it’s an enterprise team deploying at scale or a top-tier developer relying on Replit to power their business.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Serve as the trusted front-line contact for large enterprise customers, guiding them on AI prompting best practices, resolving bugs, and turning feedback into a better product experience, whilst adhering to strict SLAs.

 - Diagnose, reproduce, and resolve complex technical issues across the Replit platform.

 - Escalate and track high-impact issues with Product and Engineering, ensuring timely fixes and transparent communication.

 - Lead customer-facing communications during outages or incidents.

 - Analyse recurring issues and identify process and documentation improvements to reduce time-to-resolution

 - Build and update internal tooling, automation, and documentation that improves team efficiency.

 - Partner with Engineering, Product, Sales and other internal teams to ensure Premium customers receive a consistent, high-quality experience.

 - Help onboard and mentor other support engineers, raising the team’s overall bar for responsiveness and quality.



REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 4+ years in technical support, developer support, or systems engineering.

 - Experience managing and delivering against operational SLAs for enterprise accounts

 - Strong hands-on debugging experience with JavaScript, Python, or similar languages, including the ability to read and reason through an unfamiliar codebase.

 - Working knowledge of APIs, databases, and Git-based CI/CD workflows.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to convey technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - Familiarity with support tools like Zendesk, Linear, Slack, and internal debugging utilities.

 - Proven ability to manage multiple high-priority issues simultaneously while maintaining accuracy and composure.

 - A proactive, ownership-driven mindset and genuine empathy for customers building on Replit.



NICE TO HAVE:

 - Has used Replit in the last 3 to 6 months.

 - Experience working with IDEs, terminals, or other common developer tools.

 - Experience with AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, etc.).

 - Exposure to cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or similar).




WHAT WE VALUE:

 - Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex operational challenges systematically and devise effective solutions

 - Self-directed and autonomous: Capable of working independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams

 - Strong communication skills: Ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences

 - Continuous learning: Passion for staying current with industry best practices and new technologies

 - Focus on automation: Strong belief in automating repetitive tasks and building self-healing systems





Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🚼 Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

📱 Monthly Wellness Stipend

jobs.title: Sr. Learning Experience Lead, Onboarding & Enablement
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


Replit is building a modern, AI-native learning function, and we're looking for a Sr. Learning Experience Lead to own it. You'll own our learning platform and the onboarding and enablement experiences that run on it: designing them, delivering them, turning them into durable on-demand learning, and proving they work. This is a builder-leader role. You'll design learning, facilitate it live, build it into the platform, and measure its impact, and you'll do much of that hands-on, in the tools, the way a modern builder works.

 

You'll start close to home and grow the mandate. Your initial focus is owning the onboarding experience for our Support organization, taking it end-to-end and turning it into a real, tracked, repeatable system. Over time, you'll elevate onboarding and enablement beyond Support to the broader company, partnering with our People team, with the learning platform as the vehicle.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the learning platform. As its DRI, you own the roadmap, the learning journeys, and the instructional design behind them. You make the calls and own the outcomes.

 - Support onboarding, end-to-end. Facilitation, the live-to-on-demand pipeline, and the role-based journeys that get new team members confident and productive fast.

 - Create content and learning plans. Prescriptive learning paths and the content that fills them.

jobs.description: Per Cliente leader nel suo settore di riferimento, siamo alla ricerca di un* RESPONSABILE LOGISTICA. La risorsa, riportando alla Direzione, dovrà: Coordinare un gruppo di circa 10 persone fornendo supporto e supervisione per garantire il raggiungimento degli obiettivi. Collaborare con altri dipartimenti, come Produzione e Pianificazione, per coordinare la consegna dei materiali ai reparti di produzione e di assemblaggio. Gestire e supervisionare tutte le operazioni logistiche, garantendo l'efficienza e l'accuratezza delle attività di stoccaggio, movimentazione e trasferimento dei materiali. Assicurare il corretto ricevimento dei materiali in entrata, effettuando controlli di corrispondenza merce e quantità, garantendo l'integrità delle merci durante il processo di immagazzinamento. Ottimizzare i flussi di trasferimento dei materiali tra i due siti produttivi, definendo le opportune regole di gestione che possano correttamente bilanciare le esigenze di disponibilità dei materiali nelle aree produttive con la frequenza dei navettaggi. Supervisionare la gestione degli inventari, eseguendo controlli regolari per garantire l'accuratezza dei dati e risolvere eventuali discrepanze o errori. Utilizzare software avanzati per la gestione del magazzino, come i magazzini verticali, al fine di migliorare l'efficienza e l'automazione delle operazioni. Raccogliere e analizzare in modo strutturato con l'ausilio delle metodologie e degli strumenti più avanzati i dati relativi ai flussi fisici nelle diverse aree aziendali (accettazione, stoccaggio, reparti e bordo linee) al fine di proporre azioni di ottimizzazione volte all'eliminazione di eventuali attività a non valore aggiunto e alla riduzione di eventuali sprechi. Mappare e analizzare i flussi informativi a livello di sistema gestionale (ERP) e sistemi dipartimentali (WMS/magazzini automatici) con l'obiettivo di individuare possibili miglioramenti che rendano più completi e veloci i trasferimenti delle informazioni. Monitorare e garantire il rispetto delle normative sulla sicurezza e sulle pratiche di lavoro corrette nel magazzino. Gestire la manutenzione delle attrezzature e degli impianti del magazzino, compresi magazzini verticali e muletti. Coordinare le attività di manutenzione preventiva e correttiva, garantendo che le attrezzature siano in buone condizioni e che siano effettuate eventuali riparazioni o sostituzioni necessarie. REQUISITI Esperienza pregressa nella gestione di magazzini in realtà strutturate (meglio se operanti su commessa), preferibilmente caratterizzate dalla presenza di sistemi automatizzati (come magazzini verticali) e dall'utilizzo di software dipartimentali (tipo WMS - Warehouse Management Systems). Ottima capacità organizzativa per pianificare le attività logistiche e coordinare le risorse che a lui rispondono. Conoscenza delle best practice nella gestione del magazzino, inclusi processi di stoccaggio e movimentazione dei materiali. Leadership comprovata, con esperienza nella gestione di un team e nella delega di compiti. Capacità di analisi e problem-solving per identificare inefficienze, implementare soluzioni e migliorare i processi operativi. Familiarità con gli strumenti informatici utilizzati per l'analisi dei dati e capacità di elaborazione di report. Ottime competenze comunicative e capacità di collaborare con altri dipartimenti per garantire una gestione integrata delle operazioni. Familiarità con le normative sulla sicurezza e la salute sul lavoro relative alle attività di magazzino. RAL: 40-55K Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals.

During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you!

Compensation Structure

This role is 100% commission-based, which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results.

Training Period (Weeks 1–4)

We invest in your success and want to make sure you’re supported as you get up to speed:

By the end of training, you’ll have the skills to maximize commissions, with the safety net of a guaranteed base during your ramp-up period.

We are looking for team members who are:

jobs.title: Junior Fund Accountant (m/f)
jobs.description:
Junior Fund Accountant

The role is an entry level accounting-focused and will involve assisting our Fund accounting team in accounting and financial reporting for portfolio of funds and other structures mainly in the private equity and real estate sector. The individual will liaise with fund manager clients, third parties (including auditors) and other external advisors necessary to ensure smooth operation of the structure and to ensure that deadlines are met. Specific responsibilities include bookkeeping, assistance with periodic reporting (usually under Luxembourg GAAP or IFRS), assisting with capital calls, distributions, transactions and other day to day functions. The individual will work within a small client team, reporting on a daily basis to the relevant Langham Hall senior fund accountants and manager.

Key Responsibilities

• Accounting and bookkeeping of funds and SPVs (posting of invoices, interest and accruals etc.)
• Carry out monthly bank reconciliations and maintain all supporting documentation
• Respond to client queries and participate in client calls as required
• Assist senior team members in preparation of financial statements, using Lux GAAP and IFRS
• Assist senior team members in populating consolidation workings and intercompany eliminations
• Assist and in some cases in charge of regulatory reporting deliverables such as BCL reporting, CSSF reporting etc.
• Assist in preparation of VAT/CIT returns
• Assisting in the coordination of year-end audits;
• Prepare bank payments in various banking platforms and ensuring necessary supporting documents (including KYC documents) are obtained and attached for an efficient review process
• Assist in the process of calculating equalisation, drawdown and distribution processes and able to refer to the relevant section of the LPA/ Fund document for details of equalisation, drawdown and distribution
• Assist in calculation of management fees

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

• Graduate in Finance, Economics or Accounting
• Pro-active, motivated and eager to learn and grow in fast paced working environment
• Flexible, excellent team player and have a positive attitude towards problem solving issues
• Fluent in English (French or German would be considered as an advantage)
• Excellent organisational and interpersonal skills and able to work under tight deadlines
• The candidate will receive training and coaching required and it is not expected that the candidate hold any material prior experience, however, basic understanding of Lux GAAP and IFRS

Benefits

Langham Hall takes the development of its employees very seriously and offers sponsorship of a professional accounting qualification (e.g. ACCA) as part of the package.

About Langham Hall

Langham Hall provides premium quality accounting, fund administration and investor reporting services to Real Estate and Private Equity Fund clients.

Langham Hall invests in people and in developing them professionally.  We are extremely proud of our leadership-focused culture which fosters a dedicated, approachable and collaborative way of working.  We offer the opportunity to progress your career and study professional qualifications; through intensive training and where applicable, full exam tuition and study support.

Langham Hall is a fast-growing company and as such staff experience a variety of responsibilities and inclusion in exciting initiatives beyond their day-to-day role.  Employees are supported and encouraged to deliver a first-class service and opportunities are identified at an early stage for employees to engage with our clients which enables them feel involved and challenged in their work.

We are proud of our positive working culture which is reinforced through our employees and our extremely low staff turnover and we seek out people that believe in our values.

Learn more about Langham Hall by visiting our website: https://www.langhamhall.com/

Apply Now

jobs.title: Fund Accountant - Private Equity (m/f)
jobs.description:
Fund Accountant - Private Equity

The individual will be responsible for servicing a portfolio of real estate and private equity funds and other structures.  The individual will liaise with CFOs and financial controllers at fund managers, third parties (including auditors) and other external advisors necessary to ensure smooth operation of the structure and to ensure that deadlines are met. Specific responsibilities include bookkeeping, periodic reporting (usually under Luxembourg GAAP or IFRS), assisting with capital calls, distributions, transactions and reviewing client payments. The individual will work within a small client team, reporting on a daily basis to the relevant Langham Hall client manager.  The candidate will be expected to interface at a senior level with clients in order to problem solve and proactively deliver our services.

The successful candidate will be involved in developing other members of the team to provide a quality client-focused service.   The candidate will also have an understanding of the Luxembourg legal, tax and regulatory regimes applicable to private equity and real estate funds and other structures.  

Key Responsibilities

• Act as first point of contact for the clients in relation to all accounting and reporting matters for varied portfolio of alternative investment funds and SPVs
• Responsible for training and development of junior team members in the team through training and coaching
• Proactively build strong relationships with clients and other third party service providers (tax advisors, auditors, lawyers)
• Preparation and review of periodic financial statements, cash flows and associated notes including liaison with client over transaction related issues.
• Preparation of statutory accounts of Luxembourg funds and other structures in accordance with IFRS and LUX GAAP.
• Preparation and review of Investor NAV reporting as appropriate
• Ability to prepare and review consolidation of group of companies
• Calculation of management fees/ equalisation charges and performance fees ensuring the requirements of the key documentation (LPA/ PPM) are followed
• Dealing with year end audits including preparation of relevant files and resolving issues.
• Attendance at board and shareholder meetings and review of packs along side administration team
• Preparing Luxembourg statutory reporting and VAT and tax returns.
• Solving problems proactively using technical expertise and common-sense.
• Responsible for regulatory filings (BCL/ CSSF)
• Review bank payments in various banking platforms and ensuring necessary supporting documents (including KYC documents) are obtained and attached for efficient review process

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

• Graduate in Finance, Economics or Accounting
• The candidate will hold a professional accounting qualification at an appropriate level (ACA, ACCA or equivalent) or will be studying towards one
• Direct experience of client service in a professional services firm

jobs.title: Project Manager (m/f)
jobs.description:
Your mission

As a Project Manager, you will lead selected cross-functional projects from initiation through to successful delivery.

Working closely with teams across R&D, Production, Purchasing, Quality, Sales, IT and other key functions, you will ensure that projects are delivered in line with their technical, quality, cost and timing objectives.

Your role will be to provide structure, coordination and leadership throughout the project lifecycle while anticipating risks, solving complex issues and ensuring effective communication between all stakeholders.


Your key responsibilities

Project planning and organization

You will be responsible for structuring and organizing projects to ensure clear objectives and efficient execution:

    Set up and maintain project structures, including project timelines, team organization, budgets and resource planning

    Develop detailed project plans covering milestones, work plans, critical paths, risk management, cost and benefit analysis, staffing requirements and budgets

    Define, agree on and cascade project objectives to all relevant stakeholders

    Lead and coordinate cross-functional project teams and ensure that everyone works towards common objectives

    Organize project meetings and key review sessions, including technical reviews and launch readiness reviews

    Assign and coordinate the activities required from the different functions involved in the project

    Monitor project progress and follow up on the completion of actions to ensure the project is delivered on time


Project coordination and prioritization

In a dynamic environment where multiple requests and priorities may arise simultaneously, you will play a key role in ensuring that project resources are focused on the right activities:

    Analyze, filter and prioritize incoming requests based on project priorities, business needs and available resources

    Ensure that the prioritization of customer requests is aligned and agreed upon with the Sales team

    Manage competing priorities and support teams in maintaining focus on the most critical activities

    Coordinate the different departments involved in the project, including Manufacturing, Purchasing, Engineering, Quality, Finance, IT and Sales

    Ensure alignment between project requirements, operational capabilities and available resources


Project performance and risk management

You will actively monitor project performance and identify potential risks before they impact project delivery:

    Systematically identify, assess and manage technical, financial, operational and project-related risks

    Develop and coordinate appropriate mitigation and corrective action plans

    Monitor project performance against customer and internal targets

    Ensure compliance with technical specifications, quality requirements, development budgets, cost objectives and project milestones

    Manage project cost calculations in collaboration with Purchasing, Production and Controlling

    Monitor project profitability and contribute to the achievement of internal financial objectives

    Identify and resolve issues and conflicts within the project team whenever possible

    Escalate critical issues to management when they cannot be resolved within the project team

    Make informed decisions based on technical, financial, quality and timing considerations


Customer and supplier coordination

You will contribute to ensuring efficient coordination with external stakeholders while working closely with the relevant internal teams:

    Support customer communication regarding project timing, project status, changes and key milestones

    Coordinate customer-related actions in close collaboration with the Sales department

    Help ensure that customer expectations and requirements are clearly communicated internally

    Support the preparation of customer communications using the appropriate language and format

    Coordinate supplier-related activities and support communication with suppliers in collaboration with the Purchasing department

    Follow up on supplier-related actions that may impact project timing, cost, quality or technical requirements

    Communicate project objectives, priorities and progress to the project team and management

    Prepare and contribute to project reviews, progress reports and management updates

    Ensure that project documentation is complete, accurate and regularly updated

    Maintain project plans, action lists, risk assessments, meeting minutes and other key project records

    Record and distribute meeting minutes and ensure appropriate follow-up of agreed actions

    Use and maintain project management databases and centralized information systems to ensure reliable and consistent information

    Encourage the use of common project management tools and processes to maintain a single and reliable source of information

    Provide timely feedback on project team performance to the relevant functional managers when appropriate

Education and technical background

    Bachelor's degree in Engineering, preferably in Mechanical or Electromechanical Engineering, or an equivalent technical field

    A Master's degree would be considered an advantage

    Strong ability to understand, analyze and absorb technical information

    Knowledge of beverage systems would be a strong advantage

    Knowledge of valves and pressure regulators would also be highly appreciated


Professional experience

    At least 5 years of experience in project or program management

    Previous experience in an industrial or manufacturing environment

    Experience in sectors such as Medical, Automotive or Food & Beverage would be considered an advantage

    Proven experience managing complex and cross-functional projects

    Solid understanding of project management methodologies, tools and techniques

    Experience managing project budgets, costs and financial aspects would be an advantage


Technical and project management skills

    Strong knowledge of project planning, scheduling and resource management

    Ability to develop and manage project timelines, milestones and critical paths

    Experience with risk management and problem-solving methodologies

    Ability to monitor project budgets, costs and profitability

    Strong ability to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic and demanding environment

    Ability to filter and prioritize requests based on project and business priorities

    Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and MS Project

    Knowledge of financial management would be an advantage


Languages

    Fluent in English, both written and spoken

    French and/or German would be considered strong assets


Your professional strengths

    Excellent organizational and prioritization skills

jobs.title: Consultant Senior - Accountant  (m/f)
jobs.description:
Description des tâches:
The Senior accountant will have the following responsibilities:

-Take ownership of selected legal entities, balance-sheet areas or accounting workstreams.
-Prepare and review journal entries, accruals, prepayments and account reconciliations.
-Ensure transactions are recorded accurately, completely and in the appropriate accounting period.
-Investigate unexpected movements and resolve accounting discrepancies.
-Prepare variance analyses and explanations of material balance movements.
-Support and improve monthly, quarterly and annual closing activities.
-Coordinate with Accounts Payable, Treasury, FP&A, Tax, Group Accounting and local accounting providers.
-Analyse and account for complex, unusual or previously unresolved transactions.
-Prepare accounting position papers or technical memoranda when required.
-Support intercompany accounting, reconciliations and mismatch resolution.
-Investigate cash, bank-fee, foreign-exchange and transaction-flow discrepancies.
-Review historical balances and identify unsupported, unreconciled, duplicated or incorrectly classified items.
-Reconcile and remediate accounting data in SAP.
-Establish reliable opening balances and clear audit trails.
-Correct recurring posting, mapping and master-data issues.
-Help reinforce SAP as the primary accounting source of truth.
-Reconcile differences between the client's records and those maintained by local accounting providers.
-Prepare audit schedules, reconciliations, supporting evidence and accounting explanations.
-Respond directly and independently to external-auditor requests.
-Support statutory audits for European legal entities.
-Prepare or contribute to balance-sheet substantiation, going-concern assessments and other accounting papers.
-Maintain organised, complete and review-ready documentation.
-Document accounting procedures and month-end activities.
-Create or improve standard operating procedures, checklists and control evidence.
-Perform root-cause analysis of recurring accounting issues.
-Recommend and implement sustainable process improvements.
-Contribute to the development of the accounting control matrix.
-Use SAP and Excel for accounting operations, reconciliations and data analysis.
-Work effectively with large datasets and incomplete or imperfect source information.
-Identify accounting activities that can be standardised, simplified or automated.
-Use tools such as Power Query, SQL, automation platforms or AI where they provide a practical benefit.
-Document material automated processes so that they can be understood and maintained by the team.
-Reduce recurring errors, unnecessary manual work and operational dependencies.

Contraintes:
Extrait de casier judiciaire exigé

Études:
Niveau d'étude demandé egal Master (Bac+5)
Métier / domaine de formation:
Have at least 7 years of relevant financial accounting experience.
Demonstrate strong hands-on experience with month-end closing.
Demonstrate strong expertise in SAP S/4HANA (FI required; MM is a plus)
Have experience independently managing legal entities, material balance-sheet areas or accounting workstreams.
Demonstrate strong knowledge of accrual accounting, cut-off, reconciliations, intercompany accounting and financial controls.
Have experience investigating and resolving complex or historical accounting issues.
Have experience supporting statutory, group or external audits.
Demonstrate advanced Excel skills.
Operate effectively in multi-entity, multi-currency and complex environments.
Have experience managing local accounting and tax service providers.
Have knowledge of IFRS and European local statutory accounting frameworks.
Prepare technical accounting papers and audit documentation.
Work effectively with large datasets and incomplete information.

Be able to work independently in a fast-moving and changing environment.

Experience in accounting remediation following an ERP implementation is considered an advantage.

License or Master qualification in accounting, finance or equivalent
English speaking are mandatory, additional language is considered as an advantage

jobs.title: Security Engineer, Corporate Security
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT US:

Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.

 

In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.

 


ABOUT THE ROLE:

Millions of people rely on Notion to do their most important work. Protecting that trust starts with protecting the people who build Notion: our employees, their laptops, their identities, and the SaaS apps they rely on every day.



We are looking for a hands-on Corporate Security Engineer to own and improve the technical controls that keep our workforce and corporate environment safe. This is a security engineering role focused on building scalable controls and automation across identity, endpoints, SaaS, and workforce infrastructure, not a traditional IT support or corporate engineering role.



You'll own and evolve core security controls, design systems and automation that scale with the company, and help make security both stronger and easier to use. You'll partner closely with IT, Infrastructure, GRC, and Detection & Response to improve the security foundations that employees rely on every day.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Harden our identity and access management stack, including Okta and Google Workspace, with phishing-resistant MFA, strong SSO and SCIM lifecycles, and least-privilege access across SaaS.

 - Run our endpoint security program across a macOS-first fleet, including MDM, EDR, and configuration baselines, with working coverage for Windows and ChromeOS.

 - Secure AI tool usage at the endpoint, including governance of large language models, AI agents, and model context protocol (MCP) integrations; detect and prevent unauthorized or risky AI service access and data exfiltration through AI-enabled tools.

 - Reduce SaaS risk at scale through SSPM tooling and custom automation, including detection of risky OAuth grants, excessive permissions, shadow IT, and configuration drift.

 - Write code (Python, Terraform) to automate access reviews, onboarding and offboarding, configuration drift detection, and audit evidence collection.

 - Partner with Detection & Response to ensure corporate systems produce the telemetry needed to detect identity, endpoint, and SaaS abuse.

 - Support SOC 2, ISO 27001, and customer audits as a byproduct of good engineering, not a separate workstream.

 - Partner with Detection & Response on investigation and response for corporate security incidents, including phishing, account compromise, lost devices, and BEC.

 


SKILLS YOU NEED TO BRING:

 - Have 5+ years of hands-on experience in corporate security, enterprise security, or IT security engineering at a cloud-native company.

 - Have working knowledge of a major identity provider (Okta, Entra, or Google Workspace) and the underlying protocols (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM).

 - Have hands-on experience operating endpoint management and detection tooling across macOS and enterprise environments.

 - Write production-quality scripts and automation in Python or Bash, and have shipped Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code for security configuration.

 - Are familiar with SaaS security risks (OAuth governance, audit logging, SSPM) and the realities of integrating a long tail of vendors.

 - Have working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) at the security configuration level.

 - Communicate clearly in writing and work effectively across IT, Engineering, Legal, People, and GRC.



NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience at a fast-growing tech or AI company where the security program had to outpace headcount.

 - A background in IT engineering, SRE, or production engineering that transitioned into security engineering.

 - Experience building internal security tooling or workflows that improved employee or developer experience.

 - Contributions to the security community through open-source tools, blog posts, or conference talks.

 

We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you’re a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Bartender
jobs.description:
We are looking for an adult employee for a DJ or bartender position at a karaoke bar located in Tallinn Old Town.

Work tasks: The role includes providing professional, friendly, and efficient service to customers in the karaoke bar and ensuring that the venue’s daily operations run smoothly. Depending on the shift and operational needs, the employee’s duties may include both bar work and tasks related to DJ and karaoke services.
Bartender duties include taking customer orders, preparing and serving alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks, using the cash register system, accepting payments, and ensuring accurate transactions. The employee is responsible for keeping the bar area clean, organized, and ready for service, replenishing drink supplies and work materials when necessary, and maintaining a tidy workstation throughout the shift. When needed, the employee also helps with clearing tables, collecting glasses, serving customers in the seating area, and carrying out other daily tasks. DJ duties include operating the karaoke and music software, taking song requests from customers and managing the performance queue, selecting suitable background music, and ensuring that the karaoke evening runs smoothly. The employee uses the necessary sound and karaoke equipment, microphones, and computer programs, and assists customers in finding suitable songs when needed. The DJ is also responsible for creating a pleasant, lively, and positive atmosphere in the bar and communicating with customers in a polite and professional manner. The job also includes answering customer questions, introducing the bar’s services and offers, and assisting customers when needed. We expect the employee to be willing to cooperate with other team members and, when necessary, support colleagues with tasks in other areas in order to ensure fast and high-quality service.

We offer: We offer the opportunity to work in a karaoke bar located in Tallinn Old Town in an active and international working environment. The job is well suited to someone who enjoys communication, music, entertainment, and a varied working day.
We offer a flexible work schedule and the opportunity to work mainly in the evenings and on weekends. Previous work experience is not required, as all necessary training is provided on site. We will teach you how to use the cash register system, prepare and serve drinks, work with karaoke and music programs, and use the necessary sound and bar equipment. The employee will receive support from experienced colleagues in their daily work and will have the opportunity to develop customer service, sales, bartending, and communication skills. For a suitable and motivated employee, we offer the opportunity to take on more responsibility over time and develop within the company. Our working environment is youthful, friendly, and informal. The work is not monotonous — every evening brings different customers, songs, and situations. We value good teamwork, a positive attitude, reliability, and a willingness to learn. We offer: • on-site training and guidance; • a flexible work schedule; • an international and communication-focused working environment; • the opportunity to gain practical experience in bartending, customer service, and DJ/karaoke work; • a supportive and friendly team; • opportunities for long-term cooperation and development within the company; • internal employee discounts and benefits according to agreement.

Other requirements: The work takes place mainly in the evenings and at night, as well as on weekends, so the employee must be prepared to work according to a flexible schedule. The role requires good communication skills, friendliness, responsibility, accuracy, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.
Previous work experience as a bartender, DJ, or service employee is not required. All necessary working methods, including use of the cash register system, bar work, karaoke software, and equipment, will be taught on site. The employee will receive the necessary guidance and training when starting work and will be supported by experienced colleagues during the first working days. We are primarily looking for a motivated, reliable, and willing-to-learn person who wants to work in the entertainment and service industry and is comfortable communicating actively with a wide range of customers.

Option to work from home: No

Working load, shifts: 10-20 hours/week
; work includes night shifts

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja vakituiseen työsuhteeseen Lietoon
jobs.description:
**Lähihoitaja Lietoon Kreivinkotoon – kädet saveen, liikkeelle yhdessä ja musiikki soimaan!**

**Etsimme lähihoitajaa, joka ei pelkää laittaa itseään likoon – ja välillä laittaa myös musiikin soimaan.**

Kuulostaako siltä, että voisit viihtyä meidän porukassamme?

Kreivinkoto Lieto on ikäihmisten yhteisöllinen koti, jossa **ei vain hoideta, vaan eletään hyvää arkea yhdessä**. Meillä päivä voi sisältää lääkehoitoa ja hoitotyötä, mutta yhtä hyvin myös leivontaa, askartelua, ulkoilua, musiikkia, naurua ja kaikenlaista yhdessä tekemistä.

Etsimme nyt joukkoomme **lähihoitajaa**, joka haluaa tehdä työtä ihmisten kanssa – ei vain heidän puolestaan.

**Mitä työ Kreivinkodossa on?**

Olet tärkeä osa asukkaidemme jokapäiväistä elämää. Tuet heidän toimintakykyään, hyvinvointiaan ja itsenäisyyttään sekä olet mukana luomassa mielekästä arkea.

Työhösi kuuluu esimerkiksi:

- kokonaisvaltaista hoitoa ja huolenpitoa

- lääkehoitoa

- asukkaiden ohjaamista ja toimintakyvyn tukemista

- päivätoiminnan ja yhteisen tekemisen toteuttamista

- ulkoilua, virikkeitä ja arjen pieniä iloja

- kohtaamisia asukkaiden ja heidän läheistensä kanssa

- yhteistyötä muiden ammattilaisten kanssa.


**Ja kyllä – välillä tärkein työtehtävä voi olla istua hetkeksi alas, kuunnella ja olla läsnä.**

**Millainen tyyppi meille sopii?**

Toivomme, että olet:

- koulutukseltasi lähihoitaja

- lämmin ja helposti lähestyttävä

- oma-aloitteinen ja vastuuntuntoinen

- hyvä tyyppi tiimipelaajaksi

- kiinnostunut ikäihmisten hyvinvoinnista ja hyvästä arjesta

- valmis tarttumaan tekemiseen ja kokeilemaan uutta.


Sinun ei tarvitse osata kaikkea valmiiksi. **Asenne ratkaisee.**

Jos tuot mukanasi ripauksen huumoria, hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja halun tehdä työsi sydämellä, saatat olla juuri se henkilö, jota etsimme.

**Miksi Kreivinkoto?**

Koska meillä saat olla **lähihoitaja, ihminen ja työkaveri**.

Meillä arvostetaan toisiamme ja tehdään töitä yhdessä. Saat mahdollisuuden käyttää omaa osaamistasi monipuolisesti ja olla mukana kehittämässä asukkaidemme arkea.

Meille yhteisöllisyys tarkoittaa sitä, että **asukkaat ja työntekijät tekevät arkea yhdessä**.

Ja ehkä juuri siksi täällä ei ole kahta samanlaista työpäivää.

**Kiinnostuitko?**

Jos ajattelet, että **tuonne minä haluaisin töihin**, älä jää vain ajattelemaan – laita hakemus tulemaan!

Kerro meille lyhyesti itsestäsi ja siitä, **miksi juuri sinä sopisit Kreivinkotoon.**

**Kreivinkodossa hyvä arki ei synny itsestään – tehdään se yhdessä.**

Aloitamme haastattelut jo ennen hakuajan päättymistä, joten hae heti, niin päästään tutustumaan. Haluatko osaksi työyhteisöä, jossa kaikilla on tärkeä tehtävä ja halu menestyä yhdessä? Laita hakemuksesi Annelle (anne.holmberg@kototiimi.fi)

Lue meistä lisää www.kototiimi.fi
